rows.parityCheck: EditorSessionTests and HistoryTests: a snapshot holds the document (every Layer and Document field, compared by Document.ContentEquals) and the selection, and undo restores them; LedgerScenarioTests: the brush, the current tool and the zoom are not in it and survive undo. Narrowed in M3b: the field round trip is ContentEquals over the record, not one assertion per field.

rows.name: restoreState: order of operations, async image loading
rows.behavior: Parse; if snapshot mode differs from currentMode, switchMode(mode) first (rebuilds mask and region grid, clears regionColors, renders). Then bgColor (default '#192e44'), bgOpacity (default 1), color/opacity inputs updated (opacity input as bgOpacity*100), showMask (default true unless explicitly false), showGrid (!!), checkboxes synced; bgImage cleared then re-created from src asynchronously with render on load; regionColors replaced and every .region-btn repainted (paintRegionButton) ; layers=[] and selectedLayerId=null; if no layers: updateUI, render, updateHistoryButtons. Else each layer image loaded async (img.onload pushes layer, onerror silently drops it), when all counted finishRestore() sorts by stored order (findIndex by id), bumps nextId to max(id)+1, updateUI, render, updateHistoryButtons.
rows.quirks: (1) Selection is cleared on every undo/redo. (2) Race: restore starts with layers=[] but earlier restores' onload callbacks push into the global 'layers' array, so rapid Ctrl+Z presses can duplicate or interleave layers. (3) A layer whose image fails to load is silently dropped. (4) A layer with null imgSrc is dropped. (5) bgImage is restored asynchronously so a frame can render without it. (6) updateHistoryButtons only runs after load completes. Native sync restore removes these; list as deliberate fixes except selection clearing (decide: keep selection if id still exists).
rows.portTarget: Make restore synchronous: swap in the snapshot's layer list (bitmaps are already decoded), reset selection, rebuild region buttons, set mode. No async stage needed.
rows.parityCheck: Undo/redo through mode switch, bg color, region fill, layer add/remove and verify final composite equals the pre-mutation export pixel-for-pixel.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Restore is async with races, silently dropped layers, and selection cleared on every undo. v5: Restore is synchronous over shared immutable bitmaps and selection survives undo.

rows.name: Undo/Redo buttons and shortcuts
rows.behavior: Buttons #btnUndo ('Undo', title 'Undo (Ctrl+Z)') and #btnRedo ('Redo', title 'Redo (Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z)') enabled/disabled via updateHistoryButtons after every saveUndo and restore (initial call at load). Click: target=history.undo/redo(snapshotState()); null -> no-op; else restoreState(target). Keyboard (document.onkeydown): skipped when focus is in INPUT/SELECT/TEXTAREA or when 'Keys' toggle is OFF; Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z = redo; Ctrl+Z = undo; they run before the no-selection guard so work with nothing selected. Handlers call btn.click(), which does nothing if the button is disabled. Only e.ctrlKey is checked (not metaKey).
rows.quirks: When the Keys toggle is OFF, Ctrl+Z/Y shortcuts are also disabled (not just tool keys). Focused color/range inputs (INPUT) block shortcuts until focus moves, easy to hit after using the brush slider. Also keydown check uses e.key so Shift+Z with caps lock behaves per key value.
rows.portTarget: RoutedCommands/ICommand with CanExecute bound to history; KeyBindings Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+Shift+Z. Respect the 'Keys: ON/OFF' toggle and text-box focus exclusion.
rows.parityCheck: Disabled-state matrix after: launch (both disabled), one edit (undo on), undo (redo on), new edit (redo off). Shortcuts do nothing while typing in the template-name box.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Undo/redo shortcuts are blocked by focused sliders or color inputs and by Keys OFF. v5: Shortcuts are trapped only by text fields and Ctrl combos always work.

rows.name: Which actions create undo steps
rows.behavior: saveUndo (before mutate) is called by: add layer, duplicate layer, remove layer, layer reorder (line 630), bg swatch click (922), line 938 (verify: bg related), every draw-tool mousedown, Fit Front, F+B, Allover, Scatter, Stretch, Clear, mode toggle, presets (1734, plus nested button clicks that push a second snapshot), detail-piece creation, region fill edits via snapshotBeforeFillEdit (only if the edit touches regions), and other sites at 1662/1670/1680/2258/2519. NOT undoable on their own: select-tool move/rotate/resize drag, wheel scale, arrow keys nudge, bracket rotate, R reset rotation, +/- scale, visibility toggle (toggleLayerVisibility has no saveUndo).
rows.quirks: Drag moves are only undoable if followed by another snapshotted action AND then undone; then they are lost too because the prior snapshot predates the drag. Net: a pure drag cannot be undone. Presets cause double snapshots (preset saveUndo plus Fit Front/Allover/Scatter/F+B saveUndo) so undo needs two presses; fullbleed has a single one. Confirm 938 and 630 semantics in the owning slice.
rows.portTarget: Command pattern wrapper: every mutation goes through History.Push. Decide per row whether to keep un-undoable direct manipulations (they do get folded into the next snapshot, so undo restores the state before the last snapshotted action, including drag changes).
rows.parityCheck: Matrix test: perform each action once, press undo; compare against table of expected behavior (drag then undo reverts nothing since no snapshot was taken at drag start; undo reverts to the snapshot of the previous action).
rows.divergence: 4.1: Move, resize, opacity, flip, visibility and reorder are not undoable and presets push double snapshots. v5: Every document mutation is exactly one undo step, no empty or double steps.

rows.name: Fit Front
rows.behavior: Requires a selected layer (silently returns otherwise). saveUndo. Uses region torso_front (231,74,128x128): scale=min(r.w/imgW, r.h/imgH)*0.9, x/y centered in the region, rotation=0 (flips and opacity unchanged). Calls render() only (no updateUI).
rows.quirks: (1) No updateUI so the right-panel scale/rotation values are stale until something else refreshes them. (2) In Pants mode SHIRT_REGIONS has no torso_front (keys are waist_*), so r is undefined and the handler throws TypeError AFTER saveUndo pushed a snapshot. Decide the pants equivalent (waist_front) in the port; this is a latent Electron bug. (3) Button is enabled with no selection but does nothing.
rows.portTarget: Command FitFront on the selected layer; also raise property change so sliders refresh (fixes quirk).
rows.divergence: 4.1: Fit Front throws a TypeError in Pants mode after pushing a snapshot and does not refresh the properties panel. v5: Pants mode works via semantic slots and the panel refreshes.

rows.name: F+B (front and back)
rows.behavior: Requires selection. saveUndo. Fits selected layer to torso_front as Fit Front (0.9 factor, centered, rotation 0). Then pushes a clone ({...sel, new id, name+' (back)'}) positioned centered in torso_back (427,74,128x128) at the same scale, sharing the same Image object. Clone appended at the TOP of the stack; selection remains on the original. updateUI + render.
rows.quirks: Same pants-mode TypeError as Fit Front (torso_front/torso_back undefined). Back clone is not mirrored (despite the 'mirror' preset name). Clone inherits visibility/opacity/adjustments exactly (spread copy).
rows.portTarget: Layer clone shares the immutable bitmap reference.
rows.parityCheck: Layer count +1, clone x = 427+(128-imgW*s)/2, clone name suffix ' (back)', same opacity/adjustments/flips as the original.
rows.divergence: 4.1: F+B throws a TypeError in Pants mode after pushing a snapshot. v5: Pants mode works via semantic front/back slots, keeping the 'Mirror F+B' label and unmirrored clone.

rows.name: Stretch (across torso)
rows.behavior: Requires selection. saveUndo. Hard-coded combined box x=165,y=74,w=260,h=128 (covers right+front+left torso: 165..425). scale=min(260/imgW,128/imgH) (no 0.9 factor); centered in that box; rotation 0. Also pushes a back clone fit to torso_back with scale=min(back.w/imgW, back.h/imgH) (no margin), centered, name +' (back)'. Calls updateUI+render.
rows.quirks: Pants mode throws TypeError at SHIRT_REGIONS.torso_back.w after saveUndo (back is undefined). Hard-coded 165/74/260/128 ignore region data.
rows.portTarget: Same constants. The box is Shirt/Pants common (both use the same x,y,w,h geometry) but torso_back lookup fails in pants mode.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Stretch throws a TypeError at the torso_back lookup in Pants mode. v5: Pants mode works via semantic slots with the same geometry.

rows.name: Allover (tile on every region)
rows.behavior: Requires selection. saveUndo. For every region in the active mode (18 regions, order of definition) pushes a clone named +' tile' with scale=min(r.w/imgW, r.h/imgH)*0.8, centered, rotation 0, sharing the img. Original layer untouched and stays selected. Clones appended on top (original is below them). updateUI+render.
rows.quirks: Works in pants mode (iterates Object.values of active regions). Clones inherit the original's flips, opacity, adjustments. Large layer counts (18) swell snapshots.
rows.portTarget: Same loop over active region table.
rows.parityCheck: Layer count +18 in both modes; each clone x,y,scale checks against the formula.

rows.name: Scatter (randomized placement)
rows.behavior: Requires selection. saveUndo. For each region (active mode): count = r.w>100 ? 3 : 1 (so 128-wide faces get 3, 64-wide get 1); per copy: sc=(rand*0.3+0.15)*min(r.w,r.h)/max(imgW,imgH); scale=max(0.02,sc); x=r.x+rand*(r.w*0.7); y=r.y+rand*(r.h*0.7); rotation=rand*60-30 (uniform -30..30); name +' scat'. Share img. Clones on top. Original untouched. updateUI+render.
rows.quirks: Not deterministic; no seed exposed. Clones may extend beyond their region (x up to 70% across plus the image size). Result differs every click.
rows.portTarget: System.Random (injectable seed for tests). Same formulas. Total clones: 12 regions width>100? count: torso_up/front/back/down (w128) x4 faces x3 =12, plus 14 other regions x1 = 14 in shirt mode; verify pants identical widths.
rows.parityCheck: Seeded RNG test of bounds: scale in [0.15..0.45]*min/max, x in [r.x, r.x+0.7w), rotation in [-30,30); layer count +26 in shirt mode.

rows.name: Clear (remove all layers)
rows.behavior: saveUndo then layers=[], selectedLayerId=null, updateUI, render. Does NOT reset background color/image/opacity, region fills, mode, grid/mask toggles. No confirmation prompt. Undoable.
rows.quirks: No confirmation; button label 'Clear' might suggest clearing everything but region fills and background remain.
rows.portTarget: Command ClearLayers; no confirm dialog (parity) or optional.
rows.parityCheck: After Clear: no layers and no selection, background and region fills intact; Undo restores every layer with its image; the export of the cleared document still holds the background and region fills (DocumentOpsTests, EditGroupTests, LedgerScenarioTests). Narrowed in M3a: Undo is the Edit group's command; the Ctrl+Z key lands with M4's keyboard.

rows.name: Placement actions with no selection
rows.behavior: All five placement buttons (Fit Front, F+B, Stretch, Allover, Scatter) return silently when nothing is selected (before saveUndo). Buttons are never disabled. Clear works regardless.
rows.quirks: No user feedback when nothing happens.
rows.portTarget: CanExecute = SelectedLayer != null (disabled styling is an allowed UX improvement, note as deliberate difference) .
rows.parityCheck: Click each with no selection: no history entry, no layer change.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Placement buttons are always enabled and silently do nothing without a selection. v5: The Placement and Presets groups are hidden until a layer is selected.

rows.name: Empty-template confirm before export
rows.behavior: hasArt = any visible layer with img OR regionColors has at least one key OR a bgImage. If not hasArt, window.confirm('The template is empty — download a blank PNG anyway?') (em dash in text); Cancel aborts export, OK continues. Background color alone does not count as art.
rows.quirks: regionColors with null-valued keys (if a fill was cleared by setting null instead of delete) would count as art; check paintRegionButton/clear path. Hidden layers do not count. Background color/opacity changes alone still trigger the prompt.
rows.portTarget: MessageBox.Show with OK/Cancel and identical text; default button decision (Electron default focus is OK).
rows.parityCheck: Fresh editor + Download: confirm appears with exact text; Cancel: no file; OK: blank PNG saved. Add region fill: no prompt.

rows.name: Export composition: size, order, what is and isn't included
rows.behavior: New canvas TW x TH = 585x559 px always (independent of zoom). Steps: clearRect; background: if bgImage then drawImage(bgImage,0,0,TW,TH) stretched (aspect ignored) at globalAlpha=bgOpacity; else if bgColor not 'transparent' and not '' then fillRect with bgColor at alpha bgOpacity; paintRegions (region fills incl. gradients/patterns spanning connected groups, see lib/fills); then visible layers bottom to top via drawLayerWithAdjustments (opacity, rotate/flip, CSS filter brightness/contrast/saturate/hue-rotate, RGB shift); then globalCompositeOperation 'destination-in' with maskCanvas ALWAYS, clipping to the garment region rectangles; restore source-over. NOT included: checkerboard, Grid overlay, selection box/handles, live draw preview, UI zoom, hidden layers. Mask applies even if Show Mask unchecked. Output is transparent outside regions; background opacity <1 gives semi-transparent pixels.
rows.quirks: Preview vs export differ: preview fills bgColor unconditionally ('transparent' string would be an invalid fillStyle ignored), export guards it. Export always applies mask. Layer image smoothing is Canvas2D default (bilinear, low quality) at export; port must pick the same sampler. bgImage stretches non-uniformly to 585x559. GPU vs CPU canvas edge differences noted in the spike (exports differ by machine on Electron; native is deterministic).
rows.portTarget: SKSurface 585x559 premul BGRA; same draw sequence; SKImage.Encode PNG. CSS filter functions need exact color-matrix ports (brightness, contrast, saturate, hue-rotate per Filter Effects spec), applied via SKColorFilter; RGB shift via per-pixel add (skip alpha 0).
rows.parityCheck: Pixel-diff harness: set of fixture projects (solid/gradient/pattern/camo fills, layers with rotation/flip/opacity/adjustments, bg image at opacity 0.5) exported by Electron (GPU off) vs native; require identical except AA edges <=3/255. Verify output dims 585x559, and pixels outside region rects have alpha 0.

rows.name: Export file naming and save dialog
rows.behavior: title = #exportTitle value (placeholder 'Template name...') or 'roblox_shirt' when empty string; filename = title with every character not in [a-zA-Z0-9_-] replaced by '_' (each char individually, so spaces, dots, accents, emoji code units become '_'), plus '_roblox.png'. Not trimmed, so '  ' gives '__'. Mode (shirt/pants) is not in the default name. Mechanism: <a download href=dataURL>.click() in Electron; main.js has no will-download handler, so Electron shows its default native Save As dialog pre-filled with the name (user picks folder; cancel aborts silently). Same title field is reused by project save (default 'untitled' + '.r15proj'). Buttons: #btnExport 'Download template' (primary, tooltip 'Export the finished 585x559 PNG. Ready to upload to Roblox.') and hidden #btnExport2 wired to the same function.
rows.quirks: Sanitization works per UTF-16 code unit so surrogate pairs yield two underscores; port with string-wise char iteration to match or document diff. Also keeps '-' and '_', Windows reserved names (CON, NUL) pass through. After export no success toast and no recent-file memory. Also note: exported PNG is whatever Chromium encodes (premultiplied to straight alpha conversion rounding on semi-transparent pixels); Skia encode rounding may differ by 1 level.
rows.portTarget: Microsoft.Win32.SaveFileDialog (or Windows.Storage.Pickers.FileSavePicker for MSIX with window handle init), Filter 'PNG image|*.png', DefaultExt png, FileName per same sanitizer, InitialDirectory Downloads; write via SKImage.Encode(SKEncodedImageFormat.Png, 100) to FileStream. Handle cancel and IO errors with message.
rows.parityCheck: Table test of sanitizer: ''->roblox_shirt_roblox.png; 'My Cool Shirt!'->My_Cool_Shirt__roblox.png; 'café'->caf__roblox.png ('é' is 1 UTF-16 unit -> 1 underscore); emoji (2 UTF-16 units) -> 2 underscores. Confirm in Electron that the Save As dialog actually appears (run once) and record its default folder/behavior.

rows.name: PNG encoding and alpha handling
rows.behavior: toDataURL('image/png') of an RGBA 8-bit canvas, sRGB, no metadata chunks other than what Chromium writes, no DPI info. Semi-transparent edge/opacity pixels are stored un-premultiplied in the file (converted from premul canvas backing).
rows.quirks: Fully transparent pixels: Chromium writes RGB 0,0,0; Skia may keep colors; compare with alpha-aware diff (ignore RGB where A=0).
rows.portTarget: SKImage.Encode PNG with SKAlphaType unpremul conversion (use SKPixmap un-premul). Keep 8-bit RGBA, sRGB. Roblox requires 585x559.
rows.parityCheck: Decode both PNGs and compare RGBA after un-premultiplying; exact for alpha 0 and 255, <=1 level elsewhere. Check file is 585x559 and color type RGBA.

rows.name: Cloned layers share the Image object
rows.behavior: Fit F+B, Stretch, Allover, Scatter, preset sleeve-pop and duplicate clone layers with {...sel, img: sel.img}: all copies reference one Image. Eraser replaces only the selected layer's img; clones keep the original pixels. Snapshots store each layer's src independently.
rows.quirks: Single-slot _rgbCache keyed by layer id: with two layers with RGB shift, cache thrashes every frame (perf), and cache is only invalidated after eraser by setting layerId null; other image replacement paths are not covered here.
rows.portTarget: Immutable SKBitmap shared by reference; eraser creates a new bitmap and assigns to only that layer (copy-on-write). RGB shift cache must be keyed by (bitmap, shifts), not layer id.
rows.parityCheck: Allover then erase on one tile: other tiles unchanged.

rows.name: Snapshot size and 30-step cap behavior
rows.behavior: At most 30 prior states retained (oldest evicted silently). Redo stack unbounded but cleared on each push. Each snapshot is a string with all layers' data URLs.
rows.quirks: Cap counts no-op mousedowns (see draw-tool-start). No UI indicator of depth.
rows.portTarget: History<T> with cap 30; reference-based snapshots keep memory flat. Keep cap value 30 for parity (users see how far back they can go).
rows.parityCheck: 31st edit: first edit becomes non-undoable.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Undo cap is 30 but the redo stack is unbounded and snapshots embed every layer's PNG data URL. v5: Undo depth stays 30, redo is capped, and snapshots share immutable bitmaps.

rows.name: Mode switch interplay with undo
rows.behavior: Mode toggle button calls saveUndo then switchMode(opposite): swaps active region table, label SHIRT/PANTS with gradient, assetType select, clears regionColors (different keys), rebuilds mask and region grid, render. Undo across a mode switch calls switchMode(snapshot.mode) then reapplies regionColors and repaints buttons. Layers are NOT altered by mode switch, so shirt layers remain when switching to pants.
rows.quirks: switchMode itself does not create undo entries when called from loadProject/restoreState (intended). Layer placement helpers keyed on torso_* break after switching to Pants (see btn-fit-front).
rows.portTarget: Mode as enum with region-table lookup; snapshot includes mode; buildRegionGrid rebuilt from table.
rows.parityCheck: Fill torso_front, switch to pants (fills cleared), undo (fill returns, mode back to Shirt), redo (pants, fills empty).

rows.name: Tool shortcuts that gate canvas behavior
rows.behavior: Keys (no modifier requirement except noted): V select, B pen, L line, U rect, O ellipse, E eraser (not with Ctrl); each uses toggleTool so pressing the active drawing tool again returns to Select; Select has no toggle-off. Ctrl+D duplicates selected layer. Shortcuts ignored while focus is in INPUT/SELECT/TEXTAREA or when Keys toggle is OFF (button 'Keys: ON/OFF', green/red). Layer nudge keys act only on selected layer: arrows 1 px (Shift 10), [ ] rotate by 5 (Shift 15, normalized to [-180,180)), R reset rotation, +/= scale x1.1 (cap 5), -/_ scale x0.9 (min 0.01), Delete/Backspace remove layer. None take undo snapshots except Delete (removeLayer) and Ctrl+D.
rows.quirks: Other slice owns full shortcut list; recorded here because they gate canvas drawing state. The modulo expression ((r+step+180)%360)-180 yields wrong results for negative r below -180 (JS % keeps sign) e.g. r=-200 gives ((-200-5+180)%360)-180 = -205, not normalized. Backspace deletes a layer even on the canvas page.
rows.portTarget: InputBindings/PreviewKeyDown on window with text-input focus exclusion (TextBox, ComboBox, Slider?). Note HTML INPUT includes range and color inputs, so shortcuts are blocked when a slider/color has focus.
rows.parityCheck: Key matrix test: each key with and without selection, with Shift, with Ctrl; verify numeric results (e.g. rotation 3 + ']' = 8; rotation 178 + ']' = -177).
rows.divergence: 4.1: Ctrl+letter can toggle tools, sliders and checkboxes trap shortcuts, and '[' rotation wrap is wrong below -180. v5: Ctrl+letter no longer toggles tools, only text fields trap shortcuts, and rotation wrap is fixed to -180..180.

rows.name: Render loop characteristics that affect input
rows.behavior: Every mouse move in a draw/drag calls render(): offscreen composite of bg, region fills, all layers with filters, live preview, optional mask, then canvas.width/height reassigned (clears and reallocates view canvas), checkerboard, scaled blit, grid, handles, cursor update. No requestAnimationFrame throttle; one full render per mouse event.
rows.quirks: Heavy for many layers with CSS filters; native can improve without behavior change.
rows.portTarget: Invalidate and render on the UI thread (CompositionTarget/InvalidateVisual) with coalescing; cache the composite of static layers during a stroke or drag for performance, but output must remain identical.
rows.parityCheck: Performance budget: stroke on a 20-layer document stays at 60 fps; correctness unchanged. Open after M4b, not proven (run 2 D12). Measured baseline (FrameBudgetTests.A_pen_stroke_over_twenty_layers_reports_its_frame_times, a 120-point pen stroke on 20 layers): p95 12.6-13.3 ms with rotated, translucent layers, under 16.7 ms; 31.7-32.5 ms with color filters too, over it. The canvas host keeps one frame surface per size or DPI (FrameBudgetTests.Frames_at_a_fixed_size_allocate_one_surface_and_a_size_change_one_more), and reuse draws what a fresh host draws. Closes when the static-layer composite is cached during a stroke, or Este narrows the budget to the lighter document.

rows.name: Export depends on fill/paintRegions code paths (spike-proven)
rows.behavior: Export calls the same paintRegions(ec) as the preview so fills (solid/gradient/pattern/camo/stripes from lib/fills.js) appear identically in the PNG. Gradient spans connected region groups (touching with 4 px tolerance), grouped by fillKey.
rows.quirks: Same-key regions merge into groups; two different regions with identical fills in adjacent positions share one ramp.
rows.portTarget: Reuse spike-proven SkiaSharp fills port; add connected-group logic (union rect, touch test with tol 4).
rows.parityCheck: Gradient across torso_up/right/front/left/back/down is one continuous ramp in the export; arms/legs separate groups; matches the spike pixel-diff.

rows.name: Region fill state model (regionColors map and currentFill)
rows.behavior: regionColors is a dictionary regionName -> fill descriptor {type,c1,c2,angle,scale} (legacy values may be a bare color string, normalized by fills.normalizeFill). currentFill is the single 'active style' used for painting, default {type:'solid', c1:'#17d4fa', c2:'#f22f89', angle:45, scale:16}. HTML control defaults match: fillColor1 #17d4fa, fillColor2 #f22f89, fillAngle range 0-360 value 45, fillScale range 4-48 value 16, Solid button has 'active'. Painted regions store a COPY of currentFill ({...currentFill}), so later edits to currentFill do not touch them except through the live-edit key-match rule.
rows.quirks: fillKey ignores nothing but coerces missing angle/scale to 0 and missing c1/c2 to '' so a descriptor with explicit angle 0 and one with undefined angle share a key. Port should keep key = type|c1|c2|angle|scale exactly (case-sensitive hex strings: '#ABCDEF' and '#abcdef' are different keys; input type=color always yields lowercase, so only loaded projects can hit this).
rows.portTarget: C# record FillSpec(FillType Type, SKColor C1, SKColor C2, double Angle, double Scale) with value equality; Dictionary<string,FillSpec> RegionFills on the document ViewModel; CurrentFill property on the editor ViewModel. Keep legacy-string loader as a JSON converter that maps a string to Solid.
rows.parityCheck: A new document has empty RegionFills, and FillStyleViewModel.Current equals the default (solid, #17d4fa, #f22f89, 45, 16) with Angle held to 0-360 and Scale to 4-48 (FillStyleTests). A v4 project with string- and object-valued region entries round-trips through ProjectIOTests (M2b). Narrowed in M3a: the defaults are asserted on the view-model the XAML binds, not on the XAML.

rows.name: Template Regions grid layout (Shirt)
rows.behavior: Grid group 'Template Regions' rebuilds on every mode switch. Top block is a 5-column CSS grid, 2px gap, three rows forming a cross: row1 col3 'Top' (torso_up); row2 cols2-5 'R' (torso_right), 'Front' (torso_front, with inline background #2a1040 purple tint), 'L' (torso_left), 'Back' (torso_back); row3 col3 'Bot' (torso_down). Empty div spacers fill remaining cells (row1 c1,c2,c4,c5; row2 c1; row3 c1,c2,c4,c5). Below, 4px margin-top, a two-column grid (4px gap): left column label 'Right Arm' (9px, #666, centered) over a 4-button row (1px gap) ordered L(rarm_left), Bk(rarm_back), R(rarm_right), Fr(rarm_front); right column label 'Left Arm' over Fr(larm_front), L(larm_left), Bk(larm_back), R(larm_right). Limb up/down regions (rarm_up, rarm_down, larm_up, larm_down) have NO buttons, so they can never be painted by the grid.
rows.quirks: Painted order of limb faces differs between arms (mirrored to match the template atlas layout); keep. Grid omits arm up/down panels, so 'paint everything' via the grid never reaches 4 regions of 18; decide: keep (parity) or add buttons. Recommended: keep for 1.0, log as enhancement.
rows.portTarget: XAML Grid with 5 columns x 3 rows for the torso cross, UniformGrid(1x4) per limb inside a 2-column Grid. Region buttons are ToggleButton-like Border/Button controls bound by region key (Tag). Build from a data-driven list so Pants reuses the same template with different prefixes.
rows.parityCheck: RegionsGroupTests (M3a): 14 tiles in 4.1's cell order with its labels, each with a region automation name. The grid compared side by side with 4.1's Layout tab in the M3b look sign-off (state 02), signed off by Este on 2026-10-16 (.superpowers/m3b-look/SIGNOFF.txt). Narrowed in M3b: the grid sits on the Home tab until M4 moves it to Layout. M4b moved it back to the Layout tab (Este, 2026-10-25).

rows.name: Template Regions grid in Pants mode (labels and keys)
rows.behavior: Same structure as Shirt but prefixes switch: body prefix 'waist' (label shown only in key names; the torso cross has no body label text), limb prefixes 'rleg'/'lleg', limb headings 'Right Leg'/'Left Leg'. Cross buttons map to waist_up/right/front/left/back/down; limb rows map to rleg_{left,back,right,front} and lleg_{front,left,back,right}. The computed bodyLabel ('Torso'/'Waist') is never rendered (dead variable).
rows.quirks: Dead bodyLabel var; safe to drop.
rows.portTarget: Same template, parameterized by mode record {BodyPrefix, LimbPrefixR, LimbPrefixL, LimbLabelR, LimbLabelL}.
rows.parityCheck: Toggle to Pants; assert heading text and that clicking each button writes a region key with the waist_/rleg_/lleg_ prefix.

rows.name: Limb top and bottom tiles in the region grid
rows.behavior: buildRegionGrid offers only each limb's four sides (L, Bk, R, Fr); the limbs' up and down regions (rarm_up/down, larm_up/down, rleg/lleg in Pants) have no button, so the shoulder top and the hand or foot opening can never be filled from the grid.
rows.portTarget: RegionsGroupViewModel.Limb1Top/Limb1Bot/Limb2Top/Limb2Bot (labels Top and Bot); RegionsGrid lays each limb out as a small cross with Top above and Bot below Fr, where those regions sit on the template, as tall as the body's cross.
rows.parityCheck: RegionsGroupTests.Each_limb_has_a_top_and_a_bottom_tile (both modes, all 18 regions reachable) and A_limb_cap_paints_its_region; HomeRibbonViewTests.The_grid_shows_all_eighteen_named_focusable_tiles; ShellLookTests hold the ribbon height.
rows.divergence: 4.1: the region grid has no button for a limb's top or bottom, so the shoulder top and the hand or foot opening stay unfilled. v5: each limb gets Top and Bot tiles, so all 18 regions can be filled (Este, 2026-10-18).

rows.name: Fill all regions at once (All tile)
rows.behavior: 4.1 has no way to fill every region at once: each region button paints one region, so a full-template fill is 14 clicks (and 4 regions were unreachable, regions-limb-caps).
rows.portTarget: An ALL tile in the body cross's empty top-left cell: RegionsGroupViewModel.FillAllCommand paints every region of the mode with FillStyle.Current as one Apply (one undo step), never fitting the selected layer; right-click, Delete, Shift+F10 or Menu runs ClearAllCommand, clearing every fill in one step (no step when none).
rows.parityCheck: RegionsGroupTests: Fill_all_paints_every_region_in_one_step (both modes, undo restores), Fill_all_with_a_layer_selected_still_paints, Clear_all_clears_every_fill_in_one_step; HomeRibbonViewTests.The_all_tile_fills_and_right_click_clears_every_region.

rows.name: Region button swatch preview (paintRegionButton)
rows.behavior: When a region has a fill the button gets class 'filled' and its background is set to the CSS from fills.fillToCSS (solid color, linear-gradient(angle,c1,c2), radial-gradient(circle,...), repeating-linear-gradient stripes using max(2,scale) px bands, repeating-conic checker at scale*2, dots as radial-gradient c2 30% over c1, camo as a 135deg gradient mix(c1,c2,.5)->c1 60%->c2). When cleared, inline background is reset to '' and 'filled' removed. Called on paint, clear, live edit, grid rebuild (restores saved fill), undo/redo restore, and project load.
rows.quirks: Swatch is a CSS approximation, not the true render: camo swatch is a smooth gradient, checker/dots are tiled at screen px not template px. The inline #2a1040 tint on the Front button is wiped permanently (style.background='') after the first clear or restore of that region in the same grid build, so Front loses its purple hint. Decide: keep a consistent resting state (recommended: always show tint when unfilled).
rows.portTarget: Swatch = small SKXamlCanvas/Image control that renders the SAME SkiaSharp fill code (paintRegionFill) into a tiny bitmap at the button size, or a WPF Brush mapped from FillSpec (LinearGradientBrush, RadialGradientBrush, DrawingBrush tiles). Preferred: reuse Skia painter so swatch equals canvas; accept that this will differ slightly from the CSS approximations.
rows.parityCheck: Reworded in M4b to the fixed behavior: each swatch is the Skia fill painter's own render of the region (RegionsGroupTests.Swatch_is_the_canvas_painter_cropped_to_the_region, all 7 types), so it is not compared with 4.1's CSS approximation; a clear removes the filled look and an unfilled Front keeps its resting tint (RegionsGroupTests.Right_click_clears_a_painted_tile_in_one_step_and_ignores_an_empty_one, Undo_and_redo_repaint_tiles; HomeRibbonViewTests.The_front_tile_keeps_its_tint_after_paint_and_clear).
rows.divergence: 4.1: The Front button's purple tint is permanently wiped after the first clear or restore of that region. v5: Unfilled buttons always show the resting tint, with swatches drawn by the Skia fill painter.

rows.name: Click region button with no layer selected: paint with current fill
rows.behavior: If no layer is selected, clicking a region button calls saveUndo(), stores {...currentFill} under the region key (overwriting any existing fill), repaints that button, and re-renders. There is no toggle: clicking an already-painted region repaints it with the current style and still pushes an undo entry even when nothing changed.
rows.quirks: Painting is only reachable when no layer is selected. Selection takes priority. User must deselect first (click empty canvas, which sets selectedLayerId=null elsewhere). Redundant undo entries on repaint: consume the 30-entry history cap.
rows.portTarget: RelayCommand<string> PaintRegion(regionKey): push snapshot, set RegionFills[key]=CurrentFill with, invalidate canvas.
rows.parityCheck: No selection: paint torso_front twice with the same style through its region tile: 1 undo step, because the repaint changes nothing; Undo returns to empty (RegionsGroupTests, LedgerScenarioTests). The 7 fill types' pixels are the M1 render goldens (fills-* rows). Reworded in M3a to v5's count; 4.1 pushes 2.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Repainting a region with an identical fill still pushes an undo entry. v5: A repaint that changes nothing creates no undo step.

rows.name: Click region button with a layer selected: fit layer into region
rows.behavior: If a layer is selected, the click fits it to the region: scale = min(r.w/img.w, r.h/img.h)*0.85; x,y centered in the region; rotation reset to 0. Flips, opacity, adjustments untouched. Guard order: if the region key is missing from SHIRT_REGIONS return BEFORE saveUndo. Then saveUndo, mutate, render (no updateUI).
rows.quirks: updateUI() is not called, so the scale and rotation sliders in the properties panel stay stale until the next UI refresh. Port should refresh inspector (deliberate fix, invisible to saved files). Uses 0.85 here but Meme/Fit use 0.9, Allover/Sleeve use 0.8; keep each constant.
rows.portTarget: Same math in ViewModel command; double precision. Call UpdateInspector() as well (see quirk).
rows.parityCheck: DocumentOpsTests (M3a): a 200x100 layer fits torso_front at scale 0.544, x 240.6, y 110.8, rotation 0; LedgerScenarioTests: the properties panel shows 54%, X 241 and Y 111 right after the fit.
rows.divergence: 4.1: region-click fit leaves the properties sliders stale because updateUI is not called. v5: refreshes the inspector after the fit (unintended; saved files unchanged).

rows.name: Right-click region button clears its fill
rows.behavior: contextmenu on a region button always preventDefault (suppresses the browser/Electron context menu). If the region has a fill: saveUndo, delete the key, clear swatch, render. If no fill: nothing happens, no undo entry. Works regardless of layer selection.
rows.quirks: Hint text 'Set a style, then click a region to paint it. Right-click clears.' is the only in-app documentation (editor.html:164); keep verbatim.
rows.portTarget: MouseRightButtonUp on region button, set e.Handled=true; same logic.
rows.parityCheck: Right-click unpainted region: undo stack size unchanged. Right-click painted: stack +1, swatch cleared, canvas pixels revert. M3a smoke 2026-10-14 (UI Automation: undo counts) and 2026-10-16 (real mouse via computer use): right-click on painted FRONT cleared it as one step; right-click on unpainted BACK changed nothing.

rows.name: Fill Style hint line
rows.behavior: Static 9px #555 text under the fill controls: 'Set a style, then click a region to paint it. Right-click clears.'
rows.quirks: It does not mention that painting is blocked while a layer is selected. Consider adding that clarification.
rows.portTarget: TextBlock with same string (localization candidate; the repo has a vibe-lingual track).
rows.parityCheck: The M3b look run reads the Fill Style hint through UI Automation as 'Set a style, then click a region to paint it. Right-click clears.' (editor.html:164; .superpowers/m3b-look/v5/RESULTS.md); compared side by side in state 02, signed off by Este on 2026-10-16 (.superpowers/m3b-look/SIGNOFF.txt).

rows.name: Fill type button strip (7 types)
rows.behavior: Seven buttons in a 4-column grid, 2px gap: Solid(solid), Gradient(linear), Radial(radial), Stripes(stripes), Checker(checker), Dots(dots), Camo(camo). Exactly one has 'active' (Solid initially). Click: clears 'active' on all, sets on clicked, snapshotBeforeFillEdit(), then applyFillEdit(type = data-fill). All controls (angle, scale, colors) stay enabled for every type regardless of relevance.
rows.quirks: Active button is a view-only class: not saved, not restored by undo/redo/project load, so after loading a project or undoing the strip and sliders can disagree with currentFill. Also currentFill itself is not part of the undo snapshot or saved project. Decide: persist control state in app settings, or at minimum keep the same non-restoring behavior.
rows.portTarget: ListBox/RadioButton group (ToggleButton style) bound to CurrentFill.Type with a UniformGrid 4 columns. Each press runs the same snapshot-then-apply sequence.
rows.parityCheck: UI test clicks each type and asserts CurrentFill.Type and exclusive active state; painted regions with the old key adopt new type.
rows.divergence: 4.1: the active type button and controls can disagree with currentFill after undo or project load. v5: controls are re-synced to the current fill whenever state is restored (unintended).

rows.name: Live-edit rule: edits retarget every region sharing the current fill key
rows.behavior: applyFillEdit(mutate): compute beforeKey=fillKey(currentFill); run mutate on currentFill; every regionColors entry whose key equals beforeKey is replaced by a copy of the new currentFill. If any region changed: repaint all region button swatches that have a fill, and render(). If none matched, only currentFill changes (no render). Regions painted with a different style are untouched. Consequence: tuning angle after painting all panels rotates the whole gradient; but regions painted earlier with a style that you have since moved away from are orphaned (no longer follow the controls).
rows.quirks: Two different groups merge accidentally if an edit makes their keys equal (e.g. set stripes group's type back to a style another group already uses): from then they move together permanently because identity is by value. This is the real behavior users know; keep it.
rows.portTarget: FillEditService.Apply(Action<FillSpec> mutate) operating on immutable FillSpec via with-expressions; compare using FillKey string. Fire a single canvas invalidate.
rows.parityCheck: Scenario test: paint A,B with linear 45; paint C with solid; set angle 90 -> A,B angle 90, C unchanged; paint D (angle 90), then angle 10 -> A,B,D 10. Then change type -> all three follow. Then paint E with stripes (via type change after) etc. Compare serialized RegionFills.

rows.name: Undo snapshot timing for fill edits
rows.behavior: snapshotBeforeFillEdit saves one undo state only when the current key matches at least one painted region (fillEditWillTouchRegions), so idle slider drags create no entries. Type buttons: snapshot on click. Color inputs and range inputs: snapshot on 'pointerdown' only (one entry per drag). Then each 'input' event applies the mutation without further snapshots.
rows.quirks: Keyboard-driven slider changes (arrow keys on a focused range) fire 'input' without pointerdown, so they mutate without any undo entry, and the first color change via picker opened by keyboard likewise. Also undo restores regionColors but NOT currentFill or the controls, so after undoing, controls show the latest values while regions revert and the old key no longer matches. Decide whether to fix (recommended: snapshot on first input after focus).
rows.portTarget: Slider: handle DragStarted (Thumb.DragStarted) for snapshot, ValueChanged for apply. Color: snapshot when the picker opens, apply on color changed. Keyboard slider changes should snapshot once per focused interaction.
rows.parityCheck: Drag fillAngle with a matching painted region: exactly 1 undo step, and Undo restores the starting-angle fills in one step; a drag with no matching region: 0 steps; a keyboard slider change: 1 step (FillStyleTests). Narrowed in M3a: Undo is the Edit group's command; the Ctrl+Z key lands with M4's keyboard.
rows.divergence: 4.1: keyboard-driven slider or picker changes mutate fills with no undo entry. v5: every document mutation is exactly one undo step, and idle drags still create none.

rows.name: Color 1 and Color 2 pickers
rows.behavior: Two native color inputs (26x22 px, no border) with tooltips 'Color 1' and 'Color 2', defaults #17d4fa and #f22f89. Values are written verbatim as lowercase #rrggbb to currentFill.c1 / c2. Used by all types: Solid uses c1 only; others both (checker, stripes, dots, camo, gradients).
rows.quirks: No alpha. Native picker has no eyedropper/hex entry beyond Chromium's; the port will likely be nicer, which is fine.
rows.portTarget: A ColorPicker control (e.g. custom popup with HSV square, hex box, optional eyedropper) or WPF Extended Toolkit ColorPicker; must emit lowercase hex into FillSpec. Add ToolTip text 'Color 1' / 'Color 2'.
rows.parityCheck: Tests: ColorMathTests (HSV/RGB round trips for primaries, grays and edge hues; hex parsing), ColorPickerViewModelTests (preview, keys, hex field, commit, cancel), ColorPickerPopupTests (automation names, arrow keys, Esc/Enter, anchored on-screen placement, theme-only brushes, owner-click detection), FillStyleTests (preview, cancel, commit and unchanged picks as one or zero steps; anchor plumbing; a preview through another region's color leaves it alone), LedgerScenarioTests.A_color_pick_retargets_matching_regions_in_one_step_and_a_cancel_changes_nothing. Smoke: open Color 1 and Color 2, drag the square and hue strip and watch painted regions follow, type a hex, Esc reverts, Enter and a click outside commit, one Ctrl+Z undoes the pick. Through the bridge (H10): dragging in the square and along the hue strip repaints a painted Front live, a click on the canvas through the disabled owner commits the pick as one step with the owner hook's WM_SETCURSOR handled (no beep), and one Ctrl+Z reverts it. Narrowed in M4a: Color 1 only through the bridge; Color 2, the hex field, Esc and Enter come from the M3a themed run.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Color 1 and Color 2 open Chromium's Win32 ChooseColor dialog, which cannot be themed and changes the color only when it closes. v5: a themed in-app picker (saturation/value square, hue strip, #rgb/#rrggbb hex field, old and new swatches, OK and Cancel) opens under the swatch button, previews the color live on the canvas, and records the whole pick as one undo step (none when it ends on its seed, none on Esc or Cancel), per Este's call (2026-10-14). A click on the main window while the picker is open commits it through the owner's WM_SETCURSOR hook, which marks the message handled so Windows does not beep (M3b; checked through the M4a bridge).

rows.name: Angle and Scale sliders
rows.behavior: Angle: range 0-360 integer, value 45, tooltip 'Angle', 44px wide, accent #17d4fa, label 'Ang'. Scale: range 4-48 integer, value 16, tooltip 'Pattern scale', label 'Scale', accent #f22f89. Both convert with unary + to numbers. Angle is used by linear/stripes (and key); scale by stripes/checker/dots/camo (see lib/fills.js). Numeric readouts do not exist; the sliders are tiny (44px).
rows.quirks: Angle 0 and 360 are the same visual but different fillKeys (so a group at 360 will not merge with 0). The scale slider max 48 is the 'slider's maximum scale' used in the spike's pixel-diff.
rows.portTarget: Slider Minimum/Maximum/Value as specified, IsSnapToTickEnabled with TickFrequency=1. Keep the compact width, but consider a tooltip showing the value (additive).
rows.parityCheck: Slider bounds and defaults via automation; pixel diff of stripes at scale 4 and 48 and angle 0/45/90/360 against spike-proven painter.

rows.name: Region fills rendered in canvas with connected-component gradient extent
rows.behavior: render() calls paintRegions(ctx): group regions by fillKey; within each key group, compute connected components of touching rects; each component paints with extent=unionRect(component) so gradients are continuous across adjoining faces; solid and pattern fills ignore the extent. Regions whose key is missing from SHIRT_REGIONS (wrong mode) or with falsy fill are skipped.
rows.quirks: Slice overlap: owned by the render slice; listed here because live edit depends on it.
rows.portTarget: Port connectedRegionGroups/unionRect and paintRegionFill to SkiaSharp (spike already pixel-exact). Painted below layers, above background (confirm order in render slice).
rows.parityCheck: Narrowed in M4b: the frozen 4.1 fill goldens under the golden rule, fill-solid-all, fill-linear-0-torso, fill-linear-135-arms, fill-radial-torso, fill-stripes-30, fill-stripes-48-neg, fill-checker-12, fill-dots-16, fill-camo-16, fill-camo-48, fill-mixed-groups, fill-legacy-strings and pants-fills (GoldenRenderTests.Engine_export_matches_the_frozen_4_1_golden), plus FillsTests (Patterns_are_continuous_across_adjacent_regions, Linear_gradient_spans_a_shared_extent, Without_an_extent_each_region_restarts) and the live-edit facts (FillStyleTests.An_edit_retargets_regions_with_the_current_key_only, A_slider_drag_is_one_step_and_undo_restores_the_starting_fills), in place of a fresh native-against-Electron run at every slider extreme.

rows.name: Shirt/Pants toggle button
rows.behavior: Header button #btnModeToggle, min-width 80px, bold 13px, letter-spacing .5px, no border, radius 6, dark text #050c18. Text 'SHIRT' with background linear-gradient(135deg,#17d4fa,#f22f89) (cyan to magenta); in Pants mode text 'PANTS' with the reversed gradient (#f22f89 to #17d4fa). Click: saveUndo() then switchMode(opposite).
rows.quirks: editor.html is the live shell (cyan/magenta). Legacy shirt_editor.html (and backup/) use purple #e040fb/#7c4dff and white text; do not port those. Hidden #assetType select mirrors the mode (value 'Shirt'/'Pants') and likely feeds export or project metadata; port should keep a single Mode enum.
rows.portTarget: Button with LinearGradientBrush (StartPoint 0,0 EndPoint 1,1) bound to Mode; command ToggleModeCommand.
rows.parityCheck: ModeGroupTests (M3a): the label reads SHIRT, then PANTS. Both states compared side by side in the M3b look sign-off (states 01 and 06), gradient direction included, signed off by Este on 2026-10-16 (.superpowers/m3b-look/SIGNOFF.txt). Narrowed in M3b: the gradient endpoints are judged by eye, not sampled.

rows.name: What switchMode changes and resets
rows.behavior: switchMode(mode): sets currentMode and #assetType value; replaces SHIRT_REGIONS with a shallow copy of PANTS_REGION_DATA or SHIRT_REGION_DATA (identical rectangles, different key prefixes torso/rarm/larm vs waist/rleg/lleg); updates button text/gradient; sets regionColors = {} (wipes every region fill); rebuilds the mask canvas (union of region rects) and region grid; render(). NOT reset: layers (positions stay), selection, currentFill and fill controls, background color/image/opacity, zoom, tool, mask/grid toggles, history, detail settings. updateUI is not called.
rows.quirks: Shirt and Pants share identical rectangles, so the only functional differences are key names, grid labels, and the Details/Presets behavior that hardcodes torso_/rarm_ keys. Switching silently discards region fills (recoverable only through Ctrl+Z because of the saveUndo in the button handler).
rows.portTarget: EditorViewModel.SetMode(mode) with the same reset list; region table as two static dictionaries.
rows.parityCheck: Paint 3 regions, add a layer, toggle: layers unchanged, fills empty, grid labels/keys switch, mask identical geometry. Toggle again: fills do NOT come back (unless via undo).

rows.name: Mode switch undo semantics and other callers
rows.behavior: The button handler snapshots first (saveUndo) so the fill wipe and mode are one undo step; restoreState calls switchMode(s.mode) when the snapshot mode differs, then re-applies regionColors. loadProject (and initial restore) call switchMode directly without an undo entry. Undo/redo of a mode switch therefore swaps mode, rebuilds grid, and restores region fills (the snapshot includes mode, bg, regionColors, mask/grid toggles, layers).
rows.quirks: Snapshots serialize every layer image as a data URL on EVERY saveUndo (30 deep): memory/time heavy in Electron; native should snapshot by reference to immutable bitmaps.
rows.portTarget: History service stores full-state snapshots (immutable records) including Mode; Restore() sets mode first, then fills.
rows.parityCheck: Paint, toggle to Pants, Undo: Shirt mode with the fills restored; Redo: Pants with empty fills (EditorSession.Undo and Redo; ModeGroupTests, LedgerScenarioTests). Narrowed in M3a: the Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y keys land with M4's keyboard.

rows.name: BUG: Pants mode breaks code that hardcodes torso/arm keys
rows.behavior: In Pants mode SHIRT_REGIONS has waist_/rleg_/lleg_ keys only. Code that reads SHIRT_REGIONS.torso_front (addLayer at 502, Fit to Front/Mirror at 1328/1339, all collar/hem/seam/pocket/placket/yoke detail generators, drag-drop at 855/2272) gets undefined and throws TypeError on property access. Sleeve Pop reads rarm_* and throws on r.w. Details like cuffs, shoulder stripe, arm bands, full set also use rarm_/larm_ keys. Allover and Scatter and Fullbleed iterate Object.values or constants and still work.
rows.quirks: Users in Pants mode currently hit uncaught errors (button does nothing) after an undo snapshot is already pushed. Deliberately FIX in port (Pants torso_front == waist_front geometry is identical), record as intentional divergence.
rows.portTarget: Port should resolve semantic region names (BodyFront, BodyBack, LimbRFront, ...) through a mode-aware RegionMap so every feature works in both modes; or fix by mapping aliases.
rows.parityCheck: Test matrix: every Details button, every preset, Fit commands, drag-drop add, in both modes. Expectation for native: no exceptions. For Electron parity doc: list which fail today (all torso-key ones and Sleeve Pop in Pants mode; saveUndo already ran so the uncaught error leaves a no-op undo entry).
rows.divergence: 4.1: Pants mode throws on code that hardcodes torso/arm keys after an undo snapshot is pushed. v5: semantic slots (front/back/rarm/larm/up/down per mode) make Pants work everywhere.

rows.name: Layout presets row (6 buttons)
rows.behavior: 3-column grid, 3px gap, buttons in order: Meme Tee (meme), Allover, Sleeve Pop, Mirror F+B (mirror), Scatter (scattered), Fullbleed. All require a selected layer: with none, click does nothing and no undo entry. Otherwise handler first calls saveUndo() then dispatches. 10px font, padding 4x8.
rows.quirks: The preset handler's own saveUndo plus the delegated button handler's saveUndo means meme, allover, mirror and scattered push TWO identical undo entries per click (history.push does not dedupe, cap is 30); Sleeve Pop and Fullbleed push one. Fix in port (one entry per action) and note.
rows.portTarget: UniformGrid 3 columns with six buttons; commands share a HasSelectedLayer CanExecute (disabled state is a harmless improvement, but then keep tooltips).
rows.parityCheck: No selection: all six no-ops, history unchanged. With selection: each applies as below.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Meme, Allover, Mirror and Scatter push two identical undo entries per click. v5: every action is exactly one undo step; the Presets group is hidden until a layer is selected.

rows.name: Meme Tee preset
rows.behavior: Delegates to #btnFitFront.click(): fit selected layer in torso_front with scale=min(w/iw,h/ih)*0.9, centered, rotation 0 (extra saveUndo inside).
rows.quirks: Double undo (see presets-six-buttons). Fails in Pants (torso_front).
rows.portTarget: Call FitToFront() directly; do not re-dispatch via UI click.
rows.parityCheck: Numeric assertion of x,y,scale for a 300x200 image: scale=min(128/300,128/200)*0.9=0.384.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Meme Tee pushes a double undo entry and throws in Pants mode. v5: one undo step and it works in Pants via semantic slots.

rows.name: Allover preset
rows.behavior: Delegates to #btnAllover: for every region in the active SHIRT_REGIONS (all 18) push a copy of the selected layer named '<name> tile', scale=min(r.w/iw,r.h/ih)*0.8, centered in region, rotation 0, new id. The original layer stays selected and in place. New copies share the same img reference and inherit all adjustments, opacity, flips of the source.
rows.quirks: Source layer remains on top-left of nothing and is not removed; the copies are appended above it; nothing selects the new layers; spreads {...sel} so a layer with rotation reset only on copies. Uses Object.values order, which is JS insertion order: keep order.
rows.portTarget: Loop over active region list in declared order (insertion order of the dictionary: torso_up, torso_right, torso_front, ... larm_down) so z-order matches. Share SKBitmap across layers.
rows.parityCheck: PlacementTests.Allover_adds_one_tile_per_region_in_table_order (+18, names, z-order above the original, per-tile x, y and scale in Shirt and Pants) and Allover_first_tile_matches_4_1s_doubles; PresetsGroupTests.Allover_adds_eighteen_tiles_in_one_step. Narrowed in M4b: no preset golden exists (plan risk 7); the composite of layers at the checked geometry is held by the render goldens.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Allover pushes a double undo entry per click. v5: exactly one undo step; tile math, order and 0.8 factor kept.

rows.name: Sleeve Pop preset
rows.behavior: Creates 8 copies of the selected layer, one per arm face in order rarm_front, rarm_back, rarm_left, rarm_right, larm_front, larm_back, larm_left, larm_right. Each: name '<name> sleeve', scale=min(r.w/iw,r.h/ih)*0.8, centered, rotation 0, same img. Calls updateUI and render. Does not move the original.
rows.quirks: Only one saveUndo, unlike the delegating presets. In Pants mode it throws on first iteration (see mode-pants-crash). Decide: in Pants, apply to leg faces (recommended).
rows.portTarget: Static list of 8 semantic limb-face keys resolved through the mode map (so Pants maps to legs).
rows.parityCheck: +8 layers in the stated order with expected geometry (arm faces are 64x128).
rows.divergence: 4.1: Sleeve Pop throws on the first iteration in Pants mode. v5: applies to the sleeve/leg arm slots via semantic slots.

rows.name: Mirror F+B preset
rows.behavior: Delegates to #btnFitFB: fit selected to torso_front at 0.9 (rotation 0), then push a clone named '<name> (back)' positioned centered in torso_back using the SAME scale. Only the original is selected afterwards; no flip is applied despite the name 'Mirror'.
rows.quirks: 'Mirror' is a misnomer: duplicates, does not flip horizontally. Keep behavior, consider label. Double undo.
rows.portTarget: FitFrontAndBack(): same math.
rows.parityCheck: Exactly one new layer; positions: front centered at (231+..), back centered at (427+..), equal scales.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Mirror F+B pushes a double undo entry and fails in Pants. v5: one undo step and works in Pants; label 'Mirror F+B' and no-flip behavior kept.

rows.name: Scatter preset (randomized)
rows.behavior: Delegates to #btnScatter: for each region (all 18) add count layers (3 if r.w>100 else 1; torso and waist u/d/front/back/... wide ones get 3, 64px-wide ones get 1): scale=max(0.02,(rand*0.3+0.15)*min(r.w,r.h)/max(iw,ih)); x=r.x+rand*(r.w*0.7); y=r.y+rand*(r.h*0.7); rotation=rand*60-30 (range -30..+30); name '<name> scat'. Output is non-deterministic.
rows.quirks: Layers can overflow the region (x offset up to 70% plus image size). Not reproducible; no seed UI. Count 26 per click.
rows.portTarget: System.Random (injectable seed for tests). Same ranges/formulas. Number of regions with w>100: up, front, down, back for body = 4 per mode.
rows.parityCheck: Statistical/range test with seeded RNG: layer count = 4*3 + 14*1 = 26; every scale>=0.02, rotation in [-30,30], x,y inside region origin+70%.

rows.name: Fullbleed preset
rows.behavior: Sets selected layer scale=max(TW/iw,TH/ih) (cover the whole 585x559 template), centers on the template, rotation 0, then updateUI and render. One saveUndo. Unlike other presets it calls updateUI so the panel refreshes.
rows.quirks: Ignores the 5.0 scale cap used by keyboard zoom (cover of a tiny image can exceed it).
rows.portTarget: Same formula with TW=585, TH=559 constants.

rows.name: Keys ON/OFF toggle button
rows.behavior: Header button #btnToggleKeys, title 'Toggle keyboard shortcuts', 10px font. Starts 'Keys: ON' with background #2d4a2d and text #7fff7f. Click flips keyboardShortcutsEnabled; label 'Keys: OFF' with background #4a2d2d, color #ff7f7f when off. State is session-only (not persisted, not in project or undo).
rows.quirks: Comment says shortcuts can always be toggled, and the toggle is a button (mouse only). When OFF even Undo/Redo shortcuts are disabled (the early return precedes them).
rows.portTarget: ToggleButton bound to Settings.KeyboardShortcutsEnabled; consider persisting to app settings (improvement) but default ON each launch for parity.
rows.parityCheck: Toggle off, press V/B/Delete: nothing happens; label/colors match.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Keys OFF also disables Undo/Redo and other Ctrl shortcuts. v5: Keys OFF disables only bare-key shortcuts, Ctrl combos always work.

rows.name: Shortcut suppression while an input has focus
rows.behavior: If document.activeElement tagName is INPUT, SELECT or TEXTAREA the handler returns without acting (no preventDefault), then the enabled check. This includes range sliders, color inputs, checkboxes and the layer name box.
rows.quirks: Important user-visible quirk: after touching ANY range/color/checkbox control, focus remains on that INPUT so tool and nudge shortcuts are dead until the user clicks elsewhere (buttons are not in the list, so button focus is fine). BUTTON focus and Space/Enter not intercepted. Ctrl+Z is also blocked while a slider has focus. Decide to keep or fix by returning focus to the canvas after slider release.
rows.portTarget: PreviewKeyDown handler on the main window; skip when Keyboard.FocusedElement is TextBox, ComboBox, or other text-edit controls. Decide for sliders/checkbox/colorpicker: parity says also skip (they swallow arrows natively), recommended to skip only text-entry controls plus ComboBox.
rows.parityCheck: Reworded in M4b to the fixed behavior: in a text box V, the tool letters, Delete, Backspace, the arrows and the brackets change neither the tool nor the layers (ShortcutRouterTests.In_a_text_box_nothing_fires, The_text_tab_boxes_keep_the_tool_letters; ShellTests.Ctrl_Z_in_a_focused_text_box_never_falls_through_to_the_document; M4b smoke K1 on the template name box); a focused slider no longer traps the arrows (kbd-input-focus-trap).
rows.divergence: 4.1: focus on any slider, color input or checkbox traps all shortcuts. v5: shortcuts are suppressed only in text fields.

rows.name: Tool shortcuts V B L U O E
rows.behavior: Matched on e.key.toLowerCase(): v=Select, b=Pen, l=Line, u=Rectangle, o=Circle (ellipse), e=Eraser (not when Ctrl held; falls through). Each calls toggleTool(tool) then preventDefault and return. toggleTool: pressing the active tool again switches back to Select; Select never toggles off. Works with or without a selected layer. Shift/Alt do not block (Shift+B == b).
rows.quirks: Ctrl+V/B/L/U/O are NOT excluded: they switch tools and preventDefault, which blocks native paste (Ctrl+V), Ctrl+O open, Ctrl+U etc. (Ctrl+E is explicitly excluded.) Check whether image paste relies on a 'paste' event (none found in editor.js grep). Port decision: ignore tool keys when Ctrl/Alt held (recommended) and define Ctrl+V paste separately.
rows.portTarget: InputBindings or a central KeyRouter; ToolService.Toggle(tool). Match case-insensitively on key, not scan code (layout-dependent).
rows.parityCheck: ShortcutRouterTests.The_six_letters_map_to_the_six_tools_in_either_case and Tool_keys_run_toggleTool (repeat returns to Select, V twice stays Select), through ToolsViewModel, which the toolbar's active state binds to. Narrowed in M4b: Ctrl+V's paste moves to M5's paste row; M4b proves Ctrl+V and the other Ctrl or Alt letters toggle no tool (ShortcutRouterTests.Ctrl_and_alt_letters_leave_the_tool_alone; K3).
rows.divergence: 4.1: Ctrl+V/B/L/U/O switch tools and block native paste and open. v5: Ctrl+letter no longer toggles tools, freeing Ctrl+V paste and Ctrl+O open.

rows.name: Ctrl+D duplicate layer
rows.behavior: Ctrl+D (ctrl only; Cmd/meta not handled): preventDefault; if a layer is selected duplicateLayer(sel.id) (saveUndo; clone with id=nextId++, name+' copy', x+10, y+10, same img; inserted directly above the original; clone becomes selected; updateUI; render). Always returns, so with no selection nothing happens (and browser bookmark action is blocked). Plain 'd' does nothing.
rows.quirks: Clone copies all properties by shallow spread, including adjustments; img shared.
rows.portTarget: KeyBinding Ctrl+D -> DuplicateLayerCommand.
rows.parityCheck: Layer count +1, clone index original+1, offset (10,10), selection moved, one undo step.

rows.name: Undo/Redo shortcuts
rows.behavior: Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z -> clicks #btnRedo; Ctrl+Z -> clicks #btnUndo; preventDefault and return. Evaluated before the selection check, so they work with no layer selected. Redo branch is tested first, so Ctrl+Shift+Z is redo, not undo. Because it invokes the button's click(), a disabled button makes the shortcut a no-op. History is capped at 30 snapshots.
rows.quirks: Cmd (metaKey) not recognized for undo (irrelevant on Windows). Skipped while an INPUT has focus (see input guard).
rows.portTarget: KeyBindings to UndoCommand/RedoCommand with CanExecute from history stacks.
rows.parityCheck: Do 31 saveUndo-producing edits then 31 undos: only 30 apply. Ctrl+Shift+Z = redo.

rows.name: Selection gate and Ctrl/Meta exclusion for nudge keys
rows.behavior: After undo/redo, the handler reads the selected layer; if none returns. If ctrlKey or metaKey held it returns (so Ctrl+R, Ctrl+= and Ctrl+Backspace are left to the shell). Remaining keys use exact e.key. step = Shift?10:1 (template pixels), rotStep = Shift?15:5 (degrees).
rows.quirks: None of the transform shortcuts call saveUndo, so nudges, rotation steps, resets and scale changes via keyboard are NOT undoable (only Delete, Ctrl+D, tool changes (not undoable anyway) are). Decide: keep parity or fix (recommended: coalesce keyboard edits into an undo entry per burst).
rows.portTarget: KeyRouter with Selected layer guard; modifier test excludes Ctrl/Win. Alt is not excluded (Alt+Arrow also nudges).
rows.parityCheck: No selection: arrows no-op. Ctrl+ArrowLeft no-op.
rows.divergence: 4.1: keyboard nudge, rotate, reset and scale are not undoable. v5: every document mutation is exactly one undo step (move, resize and rotate via keys now undoable).

rows.name: Arrow keys nudge layer
rows.behavior: ArrowLeft/Right: x -/+ step; ArrowUp/Down: y -/+ step (1 px, 10 px with Shift) in template coordinates (not screen px, zoom-independent). Calls render() only (no updateUI, so X/Y fields if any stay stale), preventDefault (blocks page scroll). Key auto-repeat repeats the nudge with no throttling or clamping to the template.
rows.quirks: No bounds; no undo; no inspector refresh.
rows.portTarget: KeyDown handler; Windows key repeat rate similar. Invalidate once per event.
rows.parityCheck: Press ArrowRight 5x: x += 5; Shift+Down: y += 10.
rows.divergence: 4.1: arrow nudges are not undoable and leave the inspector stale. v5: each nudge is one undo step and the inspector refreshes; 1 px / 10 px steps kept.

rows.name: [ ] rotate and R reset
rows.behavior: '[' or '{' decrements rotation by rotStep, ']' or '}' increments (5 degrees; 15 with Shift, which also produces '{' '}' on US layouts). New value = ((rot +/- step + 180) % 360) - 180, then updateUI and render. 'r' or 'R' sets rotation 0, updateUI, render. preventDefault on all.
rows.quirks: JS % keeps sign of dividend: decrementing from -180 yields -185 (does not wrap), and keeps going more negative; the slider clamps display. Incrementing wraps correctly. Fix in port (visually identical); saved projects may contain such out-of-range values: loader must accept any double.
rows.portTarget: Implement rotation normalization with positive modulo: ((x+180) mod 360 + 360) mod 360 - 180. Rotation stored in degrees; confirm slider range is -180..180 in the inspector slice.
rows.parityCheck: From 0 press '[' 38 times: expected visual angle continues -190 etc. In Electron: value -180 then -185, -190 (unbounded). Port should produce -175, -170 ... wrap. Rendering mod 360 is identical so pixel result matches.
rows.divergence: 4.1: '[' from -180 goes to -185 and keeps drifting negative. v5: '[' rotation wrap fixed and rotation normalized to -180..180; loader still accepts any double.

rows.name: + / - scale keys
rows.behavior: '+' or '=' multiplies sel.scale by 1.1 clamped to max 5; '-' or '_' multiplies by 0.9 clamped to min 0.01; updateUI and render; preventDefault. Multiplicative around the layer's top-left (x,y unchanged), not around its center. Numpad + and - (e.key '+' '-') also match; Shift variants '+', '_' too.
rows.quirks: Scale-from-origin means the layer grows toward bottom-right. Cap 5 is lower than Fullbleed can produce.
rows.portTarget: Same constants; Key.OemPlus, Key.Add, Key.OemMinus, Key.Subtract must all map; compare by produced character to match layouts.

rows.name: Delete and Backspace remove selected layer
rows.behavior: Delete or Backspace calls removeLayer(sel.id): saveUndo; filter layer out; if it was selected the selection moves to the last remaining layer (top of stack) or null; updateUI; render. preventDefault (stops browser-back on Backspace).
rows.quirks: No confirmation. Backspace in text controls is protected by the input guard.
rows.portTarget: KeyBinding Delete/Back -> RemoveLayerCommand; same reselect-last rule.
rows.parityCheck: Delete top layer: selection falls to the new topmost; one undo step restores.

rows.name: Single document.onkeydown (no keyup, no global Escape/Space)
rows.behavior: All shortcuts live in one document.onkeydown assignment; keyup is not handled; there are no shortcuts for Escape, Space-pan, Home, zoom, or Enter in this slice. Any other code that assigns document.onkeydown would replace it.
rows.quirks: Other slices may add mouse/wheel zoom and pan; check for conflicts.
rows.portTarget: One KeyRouter service; documented table of bindings for a shortcuts help panel.
rows.parityCheck: Binding inventory test equals this list: V B L U O E, Ctrl+D, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+Shift+Z, arrows (+Shift), [ ] { }, R, + = - _, Delete, Backspace.
rows.divergence: 4.1: one document.onkeydown assignment holds all shortcuts. v5: WPF key bindings and command routing replace it, so the single-handler constraint does not carry over.

rows.name: Detail settings (color, width, Stitch)
rows.behavior: Details tab 'Settings' group: color input #detailColor default #333333; range #detailWidth min 1 max 8 value 2 (label 'W'); checkbox #detailDash labeled 'Stitch'. Values are read only at the moment a detail button is clicked; changing them does not affect existing detail layers.
rows.quirks: Settings not persisted across sessions.
rows.portTarget: ColorPicker, Slider 1-8 integer ticks, CheckBox 'Stitch' on the Details tab; state in EditorViewModel (not saved in project: confirm in save slice).
rows.parityCheck: Default values assertion; changing width after creation leaves earlier layers untouched.

rows.name: Detail button inventory and grouping
rows.behavior: 16 buttons in 4 groups (all use class preset-btn detail-btn, 10px, padding 3x7). Neckline: V-Neck(collar-v), Crew(collar-crew), Scoop(collar-scoop), Henley(collar-henley). Edges: L Cuff(cuff-left), R Cuff(cuff-right), Both(cuffs-both), Hem(hem). Seams: Center(seam-center), Sides(seam-sides), Shoulder(shoulder-stripe), Bands(arm-bands), Yoke(yoke). Accents: Pocket(pocket), Placket(placket), Full Set(full-detail, pink accent border #f22f89 text #ff5aa3). Layer names created: 'V-Neck Collar','Crew Neck','Scoop Neck','Henley Collar','Left Cuff','Right Cuff','Both Cuffs','Hem Line','Center Seam','Side Seams','Chest Pocket','Button Placket','Shoulder Stripe','Arm Bands','Back Yoke','Full Detail Set'. Unknown data-detail would be ignored.
rows.quirks: Group label 'Seams' contains non-seam items (Shoulder, Bands, Yoke). Keep labels for parity.
rows.portTarget: Data-driven DetailDefinition list (Id, Label, LayerName, Group, Draw delegate) driving the XAML ItemsControl.
rows.parityCheck: UI test enumerates labels, group titles ('Neckline','Edges','Seams','Accents'), and resulting layer names.

rows.name: Detail layer creation pipeline (canvas, style, autocrop, insertion)
rows.behavior: createDetailLayer(name, drawFn): saveUndo; make a TWxTH (585x559) transparent canvas; style: strokeStyle=fillStyle=detailColor, lineWidth=detailWidth, lineCap round, lineJoin round, and if Stitch is checked setLineDash([w*2, w*2]); run the generator; autocrop(canvas) with default pad 10 (bounding box of alpha>0, expanded 10 px, clamped to canvas); if nothing drawn return (undo entry already pushed). Else make a PNG data URL of the crop, and on image load create layer via makeLayer(img, name, crop.x, crop.y, 1) (scale 1, rotation 0, opacity 1, no adjustments), push on TOP of the stack, select it, switch tool to Select, updateUI, render. Because image loading is async the layer appears on the next tick.
rows.quirks: The generator draws in absolute template coordinates; autocrop then makes x,y reflect this so the layer sits on the template exactly where drawn. Crop uses alpha>0 so faint AA pixels widen the bounds. Zero-alpha result (not possible with current generators) would leave a dangling undo entry. Skia dash phase/cap compatibility with canvas must be verified (round caps extend each dash by w/2 on both ends so a gap of 2w becomes visually w).
rows.portTarget: Render each generator into an SKBitmap/SKSurface 585x559 with SKPaint (Style=Stroke, StrokeCap=Round, StrokeJoin=Round, StrokeWidth, PathEffect=SKPathEffect.CreateDash([2w,2w],0), IsAntialias=true) ; scan alpha for bounds; crop with 10px pad; store the bitmap as a new Layer at (cropX, cropY), scale 1, select it, set tool Select.
rows.parityCheck: The 37 frozen detail goldens (16 types solid and stitch at width 2, five at width 1 or 8) match 4.1's layer pixels and offsets (GoldenAppTests.Engine_export_matches_the_frozen_4_1_app_golden); DetailsTabTests.A_click_adds_one_selected_layer_in_one_step_at_the_engine_crop and the composed-shell facts pin the insertion. Narrowed in M4b, as M2b's detail rows: 16 x 2 x 3 combinations are not all captured.

rows.name: Detail layers ignore selection and ride on the layer stack
rows.behavior: Detail creation does not need a selected layer; result is a normal image layer (movable, deletable, adjustable, exported with everything). Position is absolute on the shirt template at creation, using the active region table. Repeated clicks stack duplicates exactly on top of each other.
rows.quirks: Duplicates are not deduplicated.
rows.portTarget: Standard Layer model; no special-casing.
rows.parityCheck: Create the same detail twice: two layers; deleting one leaves the other.

rows.name: V-Neck collar geometry
rows.behavior: Using torso_front f: cx=f.x+f.w/2=295, top=f.y=74. One path: moveTo(cx-30,top) -> lineTo(cx, top+28) -> lineTo(cx+30, top) stroked. Coordinates (265,74),(295,102),(325,74).
rows.quirks: Draws on the exact top edge so half of the stroke is clipped by the canvas only if y<0 (not the case: y=74).
rows.portTarget: SKPath MoveTo/LineTo/LineTo with round join and cap.
rows.parityCheck: Goldens detail-collar-v and detail-collar-v-stitch at width 2; layer bounds in DetailsTests. Narrowed in M2b: width 8 not captured.

rows.name: Crew neck geometry (front and back)
rows.behavior: Front: moveTo(cx-32,top); quadraticCurveTo(cx-32,top+16, cx, top+18); quadraticCurveTo(cx+32, top+16, cx+32, top) (two stroked quads, a U shape). Back collar in torso_back b: bcx=b.x+b.w/2=491; moveTo(bcx-28,b.y); quadraticCurveTo(bcx, b.y+10, bcx+28, b.y); separate stroke. One layer contains both strokes.
rows.quirks: Single layer covers both front and back so its crop box is ~226 wide including transparent middle.
rows.portTarget: SKPath.QuadTo with identical control points; two paths.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel diff plus layer bounding box (single layer spanning front and back, so wide crop).

rows.name: Scoop neck geometry
rows.behavior: moveTo(cx-38,top); quadraticCurveTo(cx, top+32, cx+38, top); single stroke. Front only (no back collar).
rows.quirks: Control point is the curve's off-curve control so depth reached is 16 px, not 32.
rows.portTarget: SKPath.QuadTo.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel diff.

rows.name: Henley collar (crew plus placket and 3 buttons)
rows.behavior: Runs the collar-crew generator, then placket line from (cx, f.y+18) down 30 px, then 3 filled circles at (cx, f.y+18+6+i*10) for i=0..2 with radius r = c.lineWidth (the FULL line width, not half). Buttons are filled with the detail color (fillStyle); they are not dashed because fill ignores dash.
rows.quirks: Stitch dash affects the placket line but not buttons. Button radius differs from placket buttons (max(1.5,0.8w)); keep both.
rows.portTarget: SKPath circle / canvas.DrawCircle with Style=Fill paint of same color.
rows.parityCheck: Goldens detail-collar-henley and detail-collar-henley-stitch at width 2, detail-collar-henley-w8 at width 8 (button radius equals width). Narrowed in M2b: width 1 not captured.

rows.name: Cuff lines (left, right, both)
rows.behavior: cuff-left: for each of larm_front, larm_left, larm_back, larm_right draw a horizontal line from (reg.x, reg.y+reg.h-8) to (reg.x+reg.w, same y) = 8 px above the bottom edge of each 64x128 face (y=475). cuff-right: same for rarm_front, rarm_left, rarm_back, rarm_right. cuffs-both calls both. Four separate strokes per arm.
rows.quirks: Unused locals r/bot in cuff-left. Arm 'down' (cap) panels get no cuff. Lines span edge to edge with round caps that overshoot the face by w/2 horizontally into neighbors.
rows.portTarget: Loop over semantic limb-face keys; DrawLine per face.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel diff; left cuff x ranges 308-570, right 19-281; bounds including pad.

rows.name: Hem line
rows.behavior: Four horizontal lines 4 px above the bottom of torso_right, torso_front, torso_left (each its own stroke; y=70+128... computed r.y+r.h-4 = 198) and torso_back (y=198). Spans each region's full width. Unused variable d (torso_down).
rows.quirks: Round caps overlap neighbor faces at the seams (right-front-left are contiguous or 2px apart: gaps at x 229-231 and 359-361).
rows.portTarget: Same loops.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel diff.

rows.name: Center seam, side seams
rows.behavior: seam-center: vertical line at torso_front cx from f.y to f.y+f.h. seam-sides: vertical lines at left and right edges of torso_front (x=f.x and f.x+f.w) full height, plus the same two for torso_back; four separate strokes.
rows.quirks: Strokes centered on the region border, so half the line lies outside the face on the adjacent (side) panels.
rows.portTarget: DrawLine.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel diff; edges at x=231,359,427,555.

rows.name: Chest pocket
rows.behavior: On torso_front: px=f.x+f.w*0.62 (=310.36), py=f.y+f.h*0.25 (=106), size pw=22, ph=24. Open-top rectangle: moveTo(px,py) -> (px,py+ph) -> (px+pw,py+ph) -> (px+pw,py), stroked (three sides, no top).
rows.quirks: Comment says 'left chest' but 62% across the front panel is the wearer's left only when viewing the front of the model; keep.
rows.portTarget: SKPath polyline with round joins.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel diff; non-integer origin x=310.36 yields subpixel AA, check Skia matches canvas AA.

rows.name: Button placket
rows.behavior: On torso_front: two vertical lines at x=cx and x=cx+5 from f.y+4 to f.y+f.h-4; then 7 filled circles at x=cx+2.5, y=f.y+8+i*spacing where spacing=(f.h-16)/6 = 18.667, radius r=max(1.5, lineWidth*0.8).
rows.quirks: At width 8 buttons (r=6.4) are wider than the 5 px column gap and overlap the lines.
rows.portTarget: DrawLine x2 and DrawCircle x7 with fill paint.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel diff for widths 1 (r=1.5), 2 (1.6), 8 (6.4).

rows.name: Shoulder stripe
rows.behavior: Horizontal line through the middle of torso_up (y=tu.y+tu.h/2=40, x from 231 to 359), plus a horizontal line through the middle of rarm_up and larm_up (y=289+32=321, full 64px width each). Three strokes.
rows.quirks: Uses the up (top cap) panels that are not paintable from the region grid.
rows.portTarget: DrawLine x3 via semantic keys.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel diff.

rows.name: Arm bands
rows.behavior: For all eight arm faces (rarm front/back/left/right then larm front/back/left/right) draw a horizontal line at y=r.y+r.h*0.35 (=399.8) across full width.
rows.quirks: Comment says 'middle' but 35% down.
rows.portTarget: DrawLine x8.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel diff; y=399.8 subpixel.

rows.name: Back yoke
rows.behavior: Horizontal line on torso_back at y=b.y+b.h*0.22 (=102.16), from b.x to b.x+b.w (427-555).
rows.quirks: Fractional y gives antialiased double-pixel row at width 1.
rows.portTarget: DrawLine.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel diff.

rows.name: Full Detail Set composite
rows.behavior: Runs collar-crew, hem, cuffs-both, seam-sides generators into ONE canvas and one resulting layer named 'Full Detail Set'. (No pocket, placket, yoke, stripe.)
rows.quirks: Single oversized layer (almost template-sized) when inserted.
rows.portTarget: Compose generators in a single bitmap.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel diff of union; single layer; bounds cover whole template area from arms to torso.

rows.name: Details behavior in Pants mode
rows.behavior: No gating: the Details tab stays available in Pants mode and still draws by hardcoded torso_/rarm_/larm_ keys, which throw TypeError (undefined.x) in Pants mode for every generator (pockets, collars, hem, seams, placket, yoke, cuffs, arm-bands, shoulder-stripe, full set). saveUndo already ran, leaving an extra undo entry; no layer is created.
rows.quirks: Treat as bug. Product decision needed whether pants should get tailored details.
rows.portTarget: Provide pants-specific detail set (waistband, belt loops, hem, side seams, pockets) or hide Details in Pants. Minimum parity-plus: make existing generators work via semantic key mapping.
rows.parityCheck: Pants mode: click all 16 detail buttons; native build must not throw.
rows.divergence: 4.1: every detail generator throws a TypeError in Pants mode because of hardcoded torso/arm keys. v5: generators resolve semantic slots so they run in Pants; pants-specific details deferred to 5.1.

rows.name: Word Art control set and default values
rows.behavior: Text tab ribbon (editor.html:226-283).
