rows.name: File group: Save work, Open, Add image, Download template
rows.behavior: Row 1: 'Save work' (title 'Save your workspace. Reopen and keep editing.'), 'Open' ('Open a saved workspace.'), 'Add image' ('Add an image file as a layer.'). Row 2: primary gradient button 'Download template' (title 'Export the finished 585x559 PNG. Ready to upload to Roblox.'; hover lifts translateY(-1px) with duo glow). Save writes .r15proj JSON via anchor download (default name from Template name field else 'untitled', non [A-Za-z0-9_-] replaced with '_'). Open uses a hidden file input accepting .json,.r15proj and resets value afterward. Add image uses hidden multiple image/* input; each file becomes a layer centered on torso_front at 0.85 fit; input value reset after. Download template exports 585x559 PNG named '<title or roblox_shirt>_roblox.png'.
rows.quirks: Electron downloads give the user no feedback or location. Empty Template name field uses 'roblox_shirt' for PNG but 'untitled' for project.
rows.portTarget: Microsoft.Win32.SaveFileDialog / OpenFileDialog (or Windows.Storage pickers in MSIX) with filters 'R15 project (*.r15proj;*.json)' and 'Images'; default file names as above. Anchor-download in Electron writes straight to the Downloads folder without a save dialog; native should show a Save dialog (deliberate improvement) or write to Downloads to match.
rows.parityCheck: Save then Open round-trip equals original state (see file-project-format); exported PNG pixel-diff against Electron output (alpha-masked, edges within AA tolerance); filename sanitation test: 'My Shirt!' -> 'My_Shirt__roblox.png'.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Save/Open/Download go through anchor downloads and hidden file inputs with no current-file model. v5: native save/open dialogs with a current-file model (Ctrl+S / Ctrl+Shift+S), same default names and 585x559 PNG output.

rows.name: Settings group: Template name, Mask, Grid
rows.behavior: Text input #exportTitle (placeholder 'Template name...', width 140, bg #1a1a2e, border #333, text #e0e0e0, 11px, radius 4, padding 3x8) used only for export and save file names (not shown on canvas, not saved inside the project, no max length). Checkbox #showMask (label 'Mask', checked by default) toggles the destination-in region mask on the on-screen render only; checkbox #showGrid (label 'Grid', unchecked) draws yellow rgba(255,255,0,.3) 1px outlines of every active-mode region at zoom scale. Both checkboxes are part of the undo snapshot and project file.
rows.quirks: The 1px strokeRect on integer coordinates straddles pixel edges producing 2px-wide 50%-alpha lines; Skia with same coordinates reproduces the same AA, so do not 'fix' by pixel-snapping unless you accept a diff.
rows.portTarget: TextBox with placeholder overlay (WPF has no placeholder: use adorner/watermark), two CheckBoxes bound to VM. Grid overlay drawn in the Skia render pass with the same stroke (SKColor 255,255,0,77; stroke width 1, rect coords r*zoom unsnapped).
rows.parityCheck: Mask off: areas outside the template show in the view and the export is still masked (view goldens with Mask off; LedgerScenarioTests). Grid on: the region outlines match the view goldens at zoom 1 in Shirt and in Pants. Narrowed in M3a: zoom 2 not captured.

rows.name: Layout tab: Presets (6 buttons)
rows.behavior: 3-column grid of .preset-btn (padding 4x8, 10px): Meme Tee (meme -> triggers Fit Front), Allover (-> Allover), Sleeve Pop (8 arm faces rarm/larm front/back/left/right get clones at 0.8 fit, name + ' sleeve', rotation 0), Mirror F+B (-> F+B), Scatter (-> Scatter), Fullbleed (scale=max(585/w,559/h), centered on the whole 585x559, rotation 0, no clone). All require a selected layer, otherwise nothing happens and no feedback. Each preset first does its own saveUndo and the delegated buttons do another, so Meme/Allover/Mirror/Scatter create TWO undo entries.
rows.quirks: Double undo entries; 'Sleeve Pop' throws in Pants mode (SHIRT_REGIONS['rarm_front'] undefined). Preset buttons have no .active state.
rows.portTarget: Six buttons invoking the same commands as Placement. Decide: collapse the double undo entry (recommended, tiny deviation) or keep.
rows.parityCheck: Meme Tee yields the same transform as Fit Front; Sleeve Pop adds exactly 8 layers; Fullbleed on a 100x100 image yields scale 5.85 and x=0,y=-13.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Meme/Allover/Mirror/Scatter push two undo entries and Sleeve Pop throws in Pants mode. v5: exactly one undo step per preset and semantic slots make every preset work in both modes, with the Presets group hidden until a layer is selected.

rows.name: Background swatches (12)
rows.behavior: Group 'Background': 12 swatch divs 24x24, radius 4, 2px transparent border, in order Navy #192e44, Navy Deep #0f1f31, Black #050c18, Charcoal #2d2d2d, Wine #4a1942, Forest #1b4332, Ocean #0c2461, Storm #2c3e50, White #f5f5f5, Red #b71c1c, Magenta #f22f89, Cyan #17d4fa; title = name. Rendered on one row (gap 3). Hover (and a never-assigned .active) = white border + scale(1.15). Click: saveUndo, set bgColor, CLEAR any background image, sync the color input value. Opacity not touched.
rows.quirks: No selected indicator ever shown (.active unused). Swatch is not keyboard reachable.
rows.portTarget: ItemsControl of Button swatches (focusable, tooltip names, AutomationProperties.Name) with RenderTransform scale 1.15 on hover.
rows.parityCheck: Click each swatch: canvas background becomes that color within template regions that are unfilled; background image removed; undo restores previous bg.
rows.divergence: 4.1: swatches are plain divs, not keyboard reachable. v5: focusable buttons with automation names and a cyan focus ring. When the background opacity is 0 (the transparent new-document default), a swatch click, a color pick or a Background image also sets it to 100% in the same single undo step, because 4.1 never touched opacity and the pick would show nothing; export is unchanged (M4b, B1).

rows.name: BG Settings: color, image, opacity
rows.behavior: Color input #bgColor (default #192e44, 30x24, no border); on input sets bgColor and clears bgImage; pointerdown snapshots undo once per gesture. Button 'Background' (id bgImageBtn, 10px, padding 3x8, btn-secondary) opens hidden #bgFileInput (accept image/*, single): saveUndo then reads file as data URL; bgImage is drawn stretched to exactly 585x559 (aspect ratio NOT preserved) at bgOpacity. Range #bgOpacity 0..100 default 100 width 80 (label 'Opacity' 9px) sets bgOpacity=v/100 applying to both bg color and bg image; pointerdown snapshots undo. There is no control to remove a bg image except picking a swatch or the color input. bgFileInput value is not reset so re-choosing the same file does not fire change.
rows.quirks: Button label says 'Background' though it picks an image. Undo snapshot taken on pointerdown even for a click without change (empty undo entry).
rows.portTarget: Color button, Button opening OpenFileDialog (decode via SKBitmap.Decode), Slider 0..100. Draw bg with SKCanvas.DrawBitmap(dest 585x559, paint alpha=opacity). Keyboard arrow changes on sliders do not snapshot undo in the original (pointerdown only); decide whether to fix.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel-diff: bg image 100x100 stretched to full canvas at 40% opacity equals Electron output; undo after bg change restores.
rows.divergence: 4.1: undo snapshot on pointerdown even when nothing changes (empty undo entry). v5: no empty undo steps, exactly one step per real background change. When the background opacity is 0 (the transparent new-document default), a swatch click, a color pick or a Background image also sets it to 100% in the same single undo step, because 4.1 never touched opacity and the pick would show nothing; export is unchanged (M4b, B1).

rows.name: Fill Style: type, colors, angle, scale
rows.behavior: 7 type buttons in a 4-col grid (.fill-type-btn, padding 3x4, 9px): Solid(active), Gradient(linear), Radial, Stripes, Checker, Dots, Camo. Color inputs #fillColor1 default #17d4fa ('Color 1'), #fillColor2 default #f22f89 ('Color 2'); labels 'Ang' + range #fillAngle 0..360 default 45 (tooltip 'Angle', width 44, cyan accent); 'Scale' + range #fillScale 4..48 default 16 (tooltip 'Pattern scale', width 44, magenta accent). Helper text: 'Set a style, then click a region to paint it. Right-click clears.' (9px #555). Changing any control updates the currentFill AND live-updates every already-painted region whose fill key equals the previous currentFill (applyFillEdit), repainting region buttons and canvas. Undo snapshot is taken on pointerdown only when the edit will touch at least one painted region. Type button click does the same snapshot rule.
rows.quirks: Live-edit couples to equal fills: two regions painted with identical fills move together, but a region painted earlier with a slightly different fill never updates. Scale slider max 48 vs lib clamps; fillToCSS clamps scale min 2.
rows.portTarget: Same controls bound to CurrentFill record {Type,C1,C2,Angle,Scale}; fill descriptor compare via FillKey string 'type|c1|c2|angle|scale' (editor.js uses lib/fills.js fillKey). Spike already proves paintRegions pixel-exact.
rows.parityCheck: FillStyleTests.The_row_scenario_runs_to_the_end_with_exact_region_fills and A_slider_drag_is_one_step_and_undo_restores_the_starting_fills (painted regions follow a drag live; one undo reverts the gesture). Narrowed in M4b: the per-type extremes are checked against 4.1's band and cell rules (FillStyleTests.Stripes_at_the_slider_extremes_follow_the_band_rule at scale 4 and 48, Checker_and_dots_at_the_scale_extremes_follow_the_cell_rule) and the frozen fill goldens (fill-stripes-30, fill-stripes-48-neg, fill-checker-12, fill-dots-16, fill-camo-16, fill-camo-48 and the rest, GoldenRenderTests); camo at scale 4 has no 4.1 capture (run 1 D5, D10). Back on the Layout tab after BG Settings, as in 4.1 (Este, 2026-10-25, reversing F1; RibbonMeasureTests.Each_tab_carries_its_groups_labels).

rows.name: Template Regions grid (dynamic)
rows.behavior: #regionGrid is rebuilt by buildRegionGrid on every mode switch/load. Layout: 5-col grid with Top (x2 column) / R, Front (inline bg #2a1040), L, Back / Bot (middle) for the body (torso_* or waist_*), then two columns for limbs: Right Arm/Leg tiles [L, Bk, R, Fr] (rarm_left, rarm_back, rarm_right, rarm_front) and Left Arm/Leg tiles [Fr, L, Bk, R] (larm_front, larm_left, larm_back, larm_right), headed by 9px #666 centered labels 'Right Arm'/'Left Arm' (Pants: 'Right Leg'/'Left Leg'; body is 'Torso'/'Waist' only in code, labels Top/R/Front/L/Back/Bot). Tiles are .region-btn divs (9px mono uppercase, padding 4, border 1px, radius 4, bg navy, color #8e9bad). Hover cyan. Filled tiles (.filled): magenta tint bg, magenta border, white text, and inline background = fillToCSS(fill) preview. Click: if a layer is selected, FIT that layer into the region (scale = 0.85 * min(r.w/imgW, r.h/imgH), centered, rotation 0, saveUndo); if NO layer is selected, paint the region with currentFill (saveUndo). Right-click on a filled tile removes its fill (saveUndo); contextmenu is prevented either way. Only the 18 template faces exist; up/down faces of arms/legs (rarm_up, rarm_down, larm_up, larm_down) are NOT in the grid so they cannot be fill-painted.
rows.quirks: A selected layer silently converts 'paint' into 'fit layer', and the hint text never says so (user must click empty canvas to deselect). The Front tile's built-in purple tint (inline #2a1040) is lost permanently once any paint/clear sets style.background (paintRegionButton clears it to ''), so after painting then clearing, Front looks like other tiles. Region tiles are not keyboard accessible.
rows.portTarget: Custom Control with Grid layout and tiles (Button) using GradientBrush previews derived from the fill (replicate fillToCSS: linear/radial/repeating stripes/conic checker/dots/camo gradient -> render each tile preview via the same Skia fill code into a small WriteableBitmap rather than approximating with XAML brushes).
rows.parityCheck: Click Front with no layer selected: region paints with current fill and the Front tile shows preview; right-click clears; with a layer selected the same click re-fits the layer instead; compare tile layout against 4.1 screenshots. Signed off at MAN-7 (Este, 2026-10-25, by eye in a live side-by-side with 4.1): the tile layout against 4.1's capture on the look page; the paint, fit, clear and keyboard clauses are proven (RegionsGroupTests, HomeRibbonViewTests).
rows.divergence: 4.1: region tiles are mouse-only divs and the Front tile permanently loses its built-in tint after any paint or clear. v5: keyboard-reachable tiles with automation names and a consistent Front tile style, with region keys resolved through semantic slots per mode. Delete, Shift+F10 and the Menu key clear a focused tile, as right-click does.

rows.name: Fill Style and the region grid read as one fill tool
rows.behavior: Fill Style and Template Regions are two .ribbon-group blocks with a 1px divider between them, and the grid is labelled TEMPLATE REGIONS, which names the template rather than what a click does.
rows.portTarget: FillStyleGroup's border drops its right divider (BorderThickness 0) and RegionsGrid's label reads CLICK REGIONS TO FILL.
rows.parityCheck: HomeRibbonViewTests pins the group labels, CLICK REGIONS TO FILL in place of TEMPLATE REGIONS.
rows.divergence: 4.1: Fill Style and Template Regions are separate ribbon groups with a divider, the grid labelled TEMPLATE REGIONS. v5: no divider between them and the grid labelled CLICK REGIONS TO FILL, so the two read as one fill tool (Este, 2026-10-18).

rows.name: Details tab: stroke settings
rows.behavior: Group 'Settings': color #detailColor default #333333 (26x22), label 'W' + range #detailWidth 1..8 default 2 (width 50), checkbox #detailDash label ' Stitch' (dashed line [w*2,w*2]). Values read at click time of each detail button; no persistence.
rows.quirks: Default color #333333 on a default navy background is nearly invisible; keep (parity).
rows.portTarget: Color button, Slider 1..8, CheckBox. SKPaint StrokeWidth=w, StrokeCap=Round, StrokeJoin=Round, PathEffect=SKPathEffect.CreateDash([2w,2w],0) when Stitch.
rows.parityCheck: Goldens detail-<16 types> and detail-<16 types>-stitch at width 2, plus detail-placket-w1, detail-seam-sides-w1-stitch, detail-collar-henley-w8, detail-placket-w8-stitch and detail-full-detail-w8-stitch (GoldenAppTests.Engine_export_matches_the_frozen_4_1_app_golden); DetailsTabTests.The_color_width_and_stitch_are_read_at_click_time. Narrowed in M4b, as M2b's detail rows: widths 1 and 8 are captured for five scenes, not every detail.

rows.name: Details tab: 16 detail generators
rows.behavior: Buttons (.preset-btn.detail-btn, padding 3x7, 10px) grouped: Neckline V-Neck, Crew, Scoop, Henley; Edges L Cuff, R Cuff, Both, Hem; Seams Center, Sides, Shoulder, Bands, Yoke; Accents Pocket, Placket, Full Set (pink border #f22f89, text #ff5aa3). Each draws a 585x559 offscreen canvas then autocrops (10px pad) into a new layer at scale 1, selected, tool reset to Select, saveUndo first. Layer names: 'V-Neck Collar','Crew Neck','Scoop Neck','Henley Collar','Left Cuff','Right Cuff','Both Cuffs','Hem Line','Center Seam','Side Seams','Chest Pocket','Button Placket','Shoulder Stripe','Arm Bands','Back Yoke','Full Detail Set'. Geometry is hard-coded from torso/arm region rects (e.g. V collar: (cx-30,top)->(cx,top+28)->(cx+30,top); crew: quadratic curves control at ±32 and a back collar; henley = crew + 30px placket + 3 buttons radius=lineWidth spaced 10; cuffs at region bottom-8; hem at bottom-4 on right/front/left + back; pocket 22x24 at 62%/25% of front; placket two lines + 7 buttons; shoulder stripe on torso_up and rarm_up/larm_up midlines; arm bands at 35% height of 8 arm faces; yoke at 22% of back; Full Set = crew+hem+cuffs+side seams).
rows.quirks: If nothing is drawn (autocrop null, e.g. Pants mode failing earlier) an undo entry is still pushed. In Pants mode every generator that references torso_/larm_/rarm_ keys throws (see bug-pants-mode-region-keys). Detail layers are rasterized at 1x so they don't scale with later torso changes. Unused vars in cuff-left (r,bot) and hem (d).
rows.portTarget: Port DETAIL_GENERATORS to SKPath-based functions with identical coordinates; autocrop on SKBitmap alpha>0 bbox +10 pad clamped, result bitmap becomes layer (x,y = crop origin).
rows.parityCheck: For each of 16 buttons, render in native and diff against Electron output (layer bitmap and offset) at default and Stitch settings; layer crop origin must match exactly.
rows.divergence: 4.1: generators throw in Pants mode and push an undo entry even when nothing is drawn. v5: generators resolve regions through semantic slots (pants-specific details deferred to 5.1) and every action is exactly one real undo step with no empty entries.

rows.name: Text tab: text, font, colors, size
rows.behavior: Group 'Text': textarea #waText (placeholder 'Type text...', rows 2, 150px wide, min-height 36, default value 'RIZZ', bg #1a1a2e border #333, resize vertical) and select #waFont (150px) with 15 options: Anton (Block), Bebas Neue (Tall), Dancing Script, Great Vibes, Pacifico (Retro), Creepster, Poppins (Bold), Lato (Modern), Bangers (Comic), Permanent Marker, Bungee Shade (3D), Rubik Mono, Press Start 2P, Righteous, Orbitron (Cyber); default Anton. Group 'Colors & Size': color inputs Fill #waColor #17d4fa, Stroke #waStroke #000000, Grad #waColor2 #f22f89 (each 28x20 with 8px #666 label), number #waSize default 64 min 8 max 300 (44px; typed values outside range are not clamped, 0/NaN falls back to 64), range #waStrokeW 0..20 default 3 ('Stroke W'), range #waAngle 0..360 default 0 ('Angle', gradient direction in radians). Every control's input and change event re-renders the preview.
rows.quirks: Number input allows values outside 8..300 when typed (e.g. 1000 would render huge). Multi-line text supported: lines split by \n, line height 1.15*size.
rows.portTarget: Multi-line TextBox (AcceptsReturn, resizable vertically via GridSplitter/Thumb or fixed), ComboBox with the same 15 display strings mapping to family names (value differs from label: value 'Poppins' label 'Poppins (Bold)'), color buttons, NumericUpDown-like TextBox (Min 8 Max 300 enforce on commit, parity keeps typed overshoot), Sliders.
rows.parityCheck: Defaults: text RIZZ, font Anton, colors/size as listed; changing each control updates preview immediately. Signed off at MAN-7 (Este, 2026-10-25, by eye in a live side-by-side with 4.1): the Text tab's look sign-off; the closed font list's label (P-1) is fixed and pinned by TextTabTests.The_font_select_draws_labels_in_the_closed_box_and_the_open_list, and the defaults and live preview are in TextTabTests.

rows.name: Word Art styles (6) and render pipeline
rows.behavior: 3x2 grid of .wordart-style-btn (Solid active by default, Gradient, Neon, Shadow, Outline, Retro; 9px, padding 3x6). Rendering (renderWordArt): font '900 {size}px "{family}", sans-serif'; canvas padded by max(strokeW*2, 10, neon 30, shadow 15, retro 12); text centered, middle baseline, per-line fill. Solid: fill, then if strokeW>0 stroke (round join) and re-fill on top. Gradient: linear gradient across angle (cos/sin * cw/2, ch/2) from Fill to Grad color. Neon: two shadow passes (blur 20, then 40, color=fill), then white fill at 0.8 alpha. Shadow: black 60% copy offset +4,+4 then solid-with-stroke. Outline: stroke only in Fill color, width strokeW||3. Retro: 8 stacked offset copies alternating Stroke color / Grad color (even i = stroke color) offset i,i then solid-with-stroke on top.
rows.quirks: Neon glow blur in Canvas is not Gaussian-sigma-equal to Skia blur; exact match may require sigma=blur/2 and a tuned test. Gradient uses cw/ch based extents but per line y; with multi-line text gradient restarts per line vertically. Stroke on outline style ignores strokeW=0 via ||3. Shadow/Retro still pad but ignore stroke color for shadow.
rows.portTarget: SkiaSharp SKCanvas.DrawText with SKFont (Embolden per font-lacks-bold rule), SKPaint with SKShader.CreateLinearGradient, SKImageFilter.CreateDropShadow / blur for neon (canvas shadowBlur=20 means sigma=blur/2=10, verify), SKPaint.Style Stroke with StrokeJoin Round. Text metrics: use font.MeasureText and baseline 'middle' = centered on (ascent+descent)/2 equivalent.
rows.parityCheck: The frozen Word Art goldens: 6 styles in Anton, Poppins and Dancing Script, multi-line Orbitron, gradient at 0 and 135, stroke 0 (outline) and 12, under the Word Art rule (WordArtSwapTests, WordArtRatchetTests, GoldenAppTests); WordArtTests pin the gradient endpoint math at 0, 45, 90, 180 and 270 and stroke 0; WordArtHardeningTests.Every_style_renders_over_the_cap_without_throwing. Narrowed in M4b, as M2b's style rows: no pixel golden at 90, 180 or 270 or at stroke 20.

rows.name: Word Art live preview canvas
rows.behavior: Group 'Preview': a container with bg #000, 1px #333 border, radius 4, min-height 44, centered (overrides the .wordart-preview CSS bg ink-950), holding canvas #waPreview (initial 200x60). updateWordArtPreview renders with maxW 200, maxH 80: canvas width/height are min(content,200/80), content is scaled uniformly by min(scaleX,scaleY) and drawn at the TOP-LEFT of the canvas (no centering), so non-matching aspect leaves blank space right/bottom. CSS also caps canvas at max-width 100% / max-height 80px. Preview re-renders on every control input/change and once after document.fonts.ready.
rows.quirks: Wide text is top-aligned in the preview box rather than centered.
rows.portTarget: A small Skia surface control (SKElement) 200x80 max with same fit logic; decide whether to center (quirk) or top-left align (parity).
rows.parityCheck: Screenshot compare of the preview region for 'RIZZ' defaults vs 04-word-art.png. Signed off at MAN-7 (Este, 2026-10-25, by eye in a live side-by-side with 4.1): the Text pair on the look page against 4.1's capture; the preview is the engine render, centered (TextTabTests.The_Preview_group_has_4_1s_pixel_values, The_default_preview_is_the_engine_render_of_RIZZ_in_Anton_cropped_to_its_content).
rows.divergence: 4.1: preview content is drawn at the top-left of the box, leaving blank space right and bottom (clearly unintended, not named in the design). v5: preview is centered in the box with the same uniform fit scale.

rows.name: Add to canvas (Word Art layer)
rows.behavior: Button 'Add to canvas' (primary, 10px, full width). saveUndo, renders at full resolution (no max size), converts to a PNG image, adds a layer named '✨ ' + first 20 chars of text + ' [' + font family + ']' (U+2728 sparkles prefix; multi-line text keeps newline characters in the name), fitted into torso_front at 0.85, centered, visible, opacity 1, selected, tool reset to Select. Uses the front region constant torso_front (fails in Pants mode).
rows.quirks: Name includes raw \n for multi-line text (displays collapsed in nowrap ellipsis span).
rows.portTarget: Command rendering SKBitmap at full size and adding Layer; layer-name text must render the emoji (Segoe UI Emoji fallback) in the layers list.
rows.parityCheck: Layer name string equals '✨ RIZZ [Anton]'; layer bitmap dimensions equal Electron (cw x ch).
rows.divergence: 4.1: Add to canvas fails in Pants mode because it reads torso_front directly. v5: the front slot resolves per mode so it works in both, with the same layer name and full-resolution bitmap.

rows.name: Asset library: packs, folder, browser
rows.behavior: Left panel h3 'Asset library' then .controls: label 'Built-in packs' with two buttons 'Drips' (title 'Load the bundled blood / liquid drip pack.') and 'Word art' ('Load the bundled word art pack.'); label 'Load folder' with 'Open folder' ('Pick a folder of PNGs to browse.', hidden webkitdirectory input). A browser region (#assetBrowser, hidden until content loaded, max-height 180px, overflow-y auto) contains subfolder filter buttons (only when more than 2 folders: '(all)'->'All (n)', '(root)'->'Root (n)', else 'name (n)', 9px, active one green #2d4a2d/#7fff7f) and a 3-column grid (gap 4) of 1:1 thumbnails (border 1px #333, radius 4, bg #111, image object-fit contain) with a 7px caption overlay (bg rgba(0,0,0,.7), color #ccc) showing filename sans extension, or the parent folder name when the filename looks like a UUID. Below it a #assetCount line (10px #555). Built-in packs resolve from packs/<name>/ in dev or resources/packs in production and read all png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp via fs; missing -> alert; empty -> alert. Folder pick filters png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp, dedupes by filename keeping the deepest path, groups by immediate parent folder ('(root)' if depth<=2), builds '(all)'. Count text: 'N unique images (M duplicates removed)'; then showAssetFolder overwrites with 'N images in all folders' / 'N images in <folder>'. Pack load sets 'N images in built-in <pack> pack' but is immediately overwritten by 'N images in all folders' (dead text). Thumb interactions: click = add as layer (named file minus extension, fit at 0.85 in front torso); right-click = add full-bleed layer 'name (full)' at (0,0) with cover scale (saveUndo); drag onto canvas = add at drop point centered; blob URLs revoked on folder switch.
rows.quirks: Bundled pack count text is overwritten immediately (quirk to drop or keep). Drop path stores the dragged file in a module global, so a cancelled drag followed by an external file drop would reuse the stale asset (_assetDragFile never cleared on cancel). Packs read synchronously on the UI thread (156 files) - port should async. File type list is inconsistent between folder import (5 types), drop zone (png jpg jpeg gif webp bmp svg) and picker (image/*).
rows.portTarget: System.IO enumeration of Packs\drips and Packs\word_art shipped as MSIX content (AppContext.BaseDirectory); OpenFolderDialog (.NET 8+ WPF) + recursive Directory.EnumerateFiles; async thumbnail generation (decode to ~96px) into an ItemsControl with UniformGrid(3); drag source via DragDrop.DoDragDrop(DataObject) and Canvas Drop; keep the 156-image (drips) scale in mind: virtualize thumbnails and decode lazily.
rows.parityCheck: Drips pack loads with its full file count (docs screenshot shows 156 images); folder pick with duplicate names removes duplicates keeping deepest; subfolder buttons appear only with >2 groups; right-click and drag behaviors; counts text matches.
rows.divergence: 4.1: packs read synchronously, thumbnails decoded at full size, stale asset-drag file reused after a cancelled drag, bundled pack count text immediately overwritten. v5: deterministic sorted packs, thumbnails decoded lazily at thumb size, stale drag bug fixed, duplicate-count label shown. Thumbnails are buttons: Enter, Space and UI Automation add them (M4a, T2-R2).

rows.name: Asset browser vertical resize handle
rows.behavior: Thin handle (#assetResizeHandle, title 'Drag to resize', height 8, ns-resize cursor, centered 40x3 bar rgba(255,255,255,.14), turns brand gradient on hover/active) under the asset count. Drag on mousedown adjusts #assetBrowser max-height = clamp(startH+deltaY, 80, 70% of window height); document cursor becomes ns-resize and text selection is suppressed during drag. Initial max-height 180px; not persisted.
rows.quirks: Handle is visible even when the browser is hidden (before any pack/folder is loaded).
rows.portTarget: Thumb (DragDelta) with Cursor=SizeNS adjusting MaxHeight of the ScrollViewer; CaptureMouse to track outside the control.
rows.parityCheck: Drag handle down 100 px: browser grows; clamps at 80 px min and 70% of window height max.

rows.name: Drop art here zone
rows.behavior: h3 'Drop art here'; dashed 2px border (rgba(255,255,255,.14)), radius 10, padding 24x12, centered 13px text 'Drag & drop PNG images' newline 'or click to browse.', color #5e6b7f, bg rgba(25,46,68,.5), margin-bottom 8. Hover and .dragover: cyan border and text, bg rgba(23,212,250,.05), inset glow 0 0 20px rgba(23,212,250,.1). Click opens a hidden multi-file image input; drop adds each image file via FileReader at the default front-torso placement; non-image files are skipped silently (console.log only). The window also prevents the default dragover/drop to stop Electron navigating to a dropped file.
rows.quirks: Async FileReader completion order can reorder multiple dropped files; no error UI when an image fails to decode (console.error only). Zone is not keyboard focusable.
rows.portTarget: Border with AllowDrop=True handling DragEnter/DragLeave/Drop (DataFormats.FileDrop), plus Click -> OpenFileDialog Multiselect. Window-level: ignore drops outside valid targets. Load files sequentially in file order (original is racy).
rows.parityCheck: Drop 3 PNGs: three layers named by filename (extension stripped) centered in front torso at 0.85 fit; dragover state visible; non-image file ignored with no dialog. Passed at MAN-4 (Este, 2026-10-25): an Explorer drop of three PNGs and a .txt with the dragover look; the in-app import order and one-step drop are unit-tested.
rows.divergence: 4.1: multi-file drops add layers in racy FileReader completion order with one undo entry each and the zone is not keyboard focusable. v5: multi-file import in pick order as one undo step and a keyboard-reachable zone. The label wraps in the narrow 200 px panel instead of clipping (M3b Task 4).

rows.name: Layer list rows
rows.behavior: h3 'Layers' with inline hint '(drag to reorder)' (10px, #555, not uppercase). Container: column, gap 4, min-height 20. Rows rendered top-to-bottom as REVERSE array order (top of list = highest z). Each .layer-item: padding 6, min-height 56, radius 6, vertical navy gradient, 1px transparent border, cursor grab (grabbing while pressed), user-select none; hover accent border; selected = cyan border + cyan/magenta tinted gradient + duo glow. Content: 48x48 thumbnail (object-fit contain, bg #000, radius 4), name (12px weight 600, ellipsis, nowrap, 40% opacity when layer hidden) and three 10px buttons row: 'Dupe' (cyan tint, title 'Duplicate layer'), 'Hide'/'Show' (title 'Hide layer'/'Show layer', text color #c4cdda or #5e6b7f), 'Del' (danger tint, title 'Delete layer'). Click row = select (and force Select tool); button clicks stop propagation. Dupe: saveUndo, clone offset +10,+10, name + ' copy', inserted directly above, selected. Hide/Show toggles visibility with NO undo entry. Del: saveUndo, removes, selection moves to the new top layer (or none).
rows.quirks: Row is not keyboard operable. Layer name tooltips absent. Hidden layers are still hit-tested? No: canvas hit-test skips !visible layers.
rows.portTarget: ListBox/ItemsControl (virtualized not needed) with a DataTemplate replicating the row; thumbnails as small cached BitmapSource (checkerboard not used, bg black). Rebuild strategy: the original rebuilds the entire list on every updateUI; in WPF bind to ObservableCollection (reverse view).
rows.parityCheck: Add 3 layers: newest on top and selected; Hide dims name to 40% and flips label to 'Show'; Dupe inserts above original; list order equals z-order of canvas. M3a smoke S6 2026-10-14 (UI Automation: newest on top and selected, Hide dims to 0.40 and reads Show, Dupe above original, list order = z-order) and 2026-10-16 (real mouse: canvas click deselects, canvas click on the layer reselects).
rows.divergence: 4.1: rows are not keyboard operable and Hide/Show pushes no undo. v5: keyboard-operable rows with automation names and visibility toggles are undoable (one step each).

rows.name: Drag to reorder layers
rows.behavior: Rows are draggable (HTML5 DnD). While dragging over another row, the pointer position relative to the row midpoint picks 'top' or 'bottom' and shows a 2px cyan border-top or border-bottom indicator on the target; the dragged row gets opacity .4. Dropping on 'top' places the layer ABOVE the target in z-order (after it in the array), 'bottom' places it below. Drop pushes one undo entry. dragend/drop-cancel clears indicators. Dropping onto itself or no target is a no-op (no undo).
rows.quirks: Dragging text/ids is set as text/plain id; harmless.
rows.portTarget: WPF drag/drop with insertion-line adorner; compute above/below from pointer Y vs row midpoint; reorder the backing list preserving the same z semantics.
rows.parityCheck: Through the bridge (H7, H7b): the bottom row dropped on the top half of the top row becomes the top while the drop line shows above that row; a drag released off every row, or cancelled with Esc, moves nothing and leaves no mark; with 20 layers the left panel wheels down mid-drag and the drop lands below the last row; Alt+Up moves a focused row one place; and one Ctrl+Z (the window's KeyBinding) undoes each. LayersReorderTests, LayersPanelDragTests, ShellTests and LedgerScenarioTests pin the same; a lost capture (Alt+Tab) cancelling the drag is pinned by LayersPanelDragTests only. Narrowed in M4a: the gesture is real WPF routed input injected in-process by the test-only input bridge (brg smoke; interfaces R7, R8) and read back through its inspect command and UI Automation; the bridge cannot show the OS cursor image or drive a physical device (H7, H7b).
rows.divergence: 4.1: reorder is mouse-drag only and can leave a stale drag target. v5: stale drag target fixed and reorder is keyboard operable, with the same above/below z semantics and one undo step. Pressing a row selects it, so a dragged row ends selected; Alt+Up and Alt+Down move a focused row (M3b Task 4).

rows.name: Selected layer controls
rows.behavior: h3 'Selected layer'; with no selection shows 'Select a layer to edit.' (.info mono 10px uppercase #5e6b7f). With a selection (rebuilt by updateUI) shows: Name text input (#ctrlName, change commits, refreshes list); 'X: n Y: n' label (integers) plus two number inputs ctrlX/ctrlY (50% each; change commits; value toFixed(0)); 'Scale: n%' + range 1..500 (value = scale*100, oninput live); 'Rotation: n°' + range -180..180; 'Opacity: n%' + range 0..100; button rows: Flip H / Flip V / Duplicate (titles 'Flip horizontally.', 'Flip vertically.', 'Duplicate layer.'), Up / Down ('Move layer up.'/'Move layer down.'; swap with neighbor in z-order, no-op at ends), full-width 'Center on front torso'. Then a collapsible 'Image adjustments' header (cyan mono 11px uppercase, arrow ▶/▼ toggles) containing Brightness 0..200, Contrast 0..200, Saturation 0..200 (all %, default 100), Hue rotate 0..360 deg (default 0), R/G/B sliders -100..100 default 0 (accent red #ff5472, green #4f4, blue #66f; label colors same) and 'Reset adjustments' (magenta border/text) which resets all 7 and rebuilds panel.
rows.quirks: (1) brightness/contrast/saturation slider reload uses `value || 100`, so a legitimate 0 is shown as 100 after any panel rebuild even though the layer is really at 0 (display mismatch). (2) Scale label shows rounded percent but slider can't exceed 500 while wheel/handle resize allows >500% (and as low as 1%); the keyboard +/- clamps 0.01..5. (3) Rotation label prints unrounded float (e.g. 12.3456789°) after handle rotation. (4) The adjustments panel collapses on every updateUI rebuild (e.g. after wheel scale, reset, rotate via handle). (5) X/Y inputs and X:/Y: label do not refresh while dragging a layer with the mouse (only on next rebuild). (6) None of the slider/number/name/flip/move/center/adjust changes push undo. (7) Slider events fire at 'input' rate; each rebuild loses focus.
rows.portTarget: A Selected Layer inspector (StackPanel) bound to the selected Layer VM (two-way). Adjustments applied via the render pipeline: brightness/contrast/saturate/hue-rotate follow the CSS filter definitions (feColorMatrix-equivalent) and must be re-implemented with SKColorFilter matrices matching CSS Filter Effects spec (brightness = linear multiply, contrast = slope with 0.5 offset, saturate matrix per spec with luma 0.2126/0.7152/0.0722, hue-rotate matrix per spec).
rows.parityCheck: Narrowed in M4b: the frozen 4.1 goldens adjust-brightness-150, adjust-contrast-40, adjust-saturate-0, adjust-hue-90, adjust-extremes, adjust-combo, gap-opacity-with-adjust, rgb-shift and rgb-shift-with-adjust-rotated under the golden rule (GoldenRenderTests.Engine_export_matches_the_frozen_4_1_golden), AdjustTests (the brightness, contrast, saturate and hue-rotate tables and matrices; Rgb_shift_is_exact_clamped_and_skips_transparent_pixels), LayerPropertiesPanelTests.The_ten_sliders_have_4_1s_ranges and LayerPropertiesViewModelTests (Each_adjustment_is_one_clamped_step_that_keeps_the_others, Zero_adjustments_show_as_zero_after_reselect), in place of 4.1 renders at every sample value; LayerPropertiesViewModelTests pin the fixed displays (an adjustment of 0 shows 0, The_adjustments_stay_open_across_selection_edits_and_undo, The_rotation_slider_is_whole_degrees_in_range); LayerPropertiesPanelTests pin Center on front torso (Center_on_front_torso_is_one_undo_step_that_leaves_scale_and_rotation_alone, The_center_button_is_full_width_between_Up_Down_and_the_adjustments).
rows.divergence: 4.1: adjustment 0 shows as 100 after rebuild, adjustments panel collapses on every rebuild, rotation label unrounded, X/Y stale while dragging, and move/resize/opacity/flip/reorder push no undo. v5: 0 displays as 0, panel stays open, rotation label rounded, every document mutation is exactly one undo step, and one scale clamp 1%-500% applies to slider, keys, wheel and handles.

rows.name: Adjustment render order and RGB shift cache
rows.behavior: Per layer draw: save, globalAlpha=opacity, translate to layer center, rotate by rotation deg (CW, canvas), flipH/flipV via scale(-1,1)/(1,-1) AFTER rotation, ctx.filter = 'brightness(b%) contrast(c%) saturate(s%) hue-rotate(hdeg)' only when any adjustment non-default (hasAdjustments includes RGB), then draws either the RGB-shifted offscreen (per-channel add clamped 0..255, skipping alpha=0 pixels) or the raw image at scaled size. RGB shift result is cached for a single layer id + (r,g,b); eraser edits invalidate it.
rows.quirks: The off-screen target is drawn without explicit smoothing quality (default 'low' bilinear) so Skia sampling options must be SKSamplingOptions(Linear) to match; the final zoomed blit uses smoothing only when zoom<1 (nearest at zoom>=1).
rows.portTarget: Apply SKColorFilter chain in the same order (RGB offset first, then filter chain as ctx.filter does: image data shift happens BEFORE the filter because the shifted canvas is what the filter draws). Note ctx.filter order is brightness->contrast->saturate->hue-rotate.
rows.parityCheck: Matrix of (brightness,contrast,saturate,hue,r,g,b) test layers pixel-diffed against Electron; interpolation: image drawn with Chromium default smoothing (imageSmoothingEnabled true at zoom>=1 for layers drawn into the 585x559 offscreen).
rows.divergence: 4.1: Chromium ctx.filter chain with RGB shift applied on premultiplied canvas data. v5: per-stage CSS filter color matrices in the same order with RGB shift on unpremultiplied pixels (more precise on low alpha).

rows.name: Main canvas, zoom and compositing order
rows.behavior: #mainCanvas intrinsic 585x559; each render() composites on an offscreen 585x559: bg (image stretched or color) with bgOpacity, region fills (paintRegions), visible layers bottom->top with adjustments, live draw preview (eraser at 50% alpha), then if Mask on a destination-in with the template region mask (union of active-mode rects). The visible canvas is then resized to 585*zoom x 559*zoom EVERY render (so each render clears it), filled with a 16x16 checkerboard (#0f1f31 base with #050c18 squares at 8px, tiled at canvas pixel scale not zoomed) and the offscreen is drawn scaled (smoothing only when zoom<1). Overlays: Grid (if on), then selection UI (only in Select tool with a selection). Canvas has cursor crosshair; .canvas-wrap has 1px border rgba(255,255,255,.08), shadow-2 and a CSS conic checker background (not visible beneath the canvas). .canvas-area is ink-950, flex-centered with overflow hidden.
rows.quirks: The checkerboard stays 16px regardless of zoom. Edge AA differences versus Electron GPU canvas exist (spike finding): port should be consistent software-raster.
rows.portTarget: SKElement (SkiaSharp.Views.WPF) host drawing in device pixels at zoom; keep the same compositing order, destination-in mask via SKBlendMode.DstIn, nearest-neighbor when zoom>=1 and linear when zoom<1.
rows.parityCheck: View goldens (tests/goldens/view): the visible canvas at zoom 0.25, 0.5, 1, 1.5 and 3, with region fills and layers, Mask on and off, under the unchanged golden rule; the checkerboard is not scaled with zoom. Narrowed in M3a: zoom 2 not captured.

rows.name: Zoom controls
rows.behavior: Pill overlay (position absolute bottom 12 right 12, bg rgba(15,31,49,.85), blur(8px) backdrop, 1px border, radius pill, padding 4x8, gap 8) with buttons '-' and '+' (16px, no bg) around a 36px-min-width mono 11px text '100%'. Zoom steps +/-0.25, clamp 0.25..3.0 (25%..300%), starts 100%; label '(zoom*100)%' (e.g. '125%'). Zoom does not change layer data, just display scale; there are no zoom keyboard shortcuts, no wheel zoom (wheel scales layer / brush), no fit-to-window, no pan. At zoom>1 the canvas (up to 1755x1677) is bigger than the area and is clipped (overflow hidden, centered), with NO scrollbars or panning, so edges are unreachable.
rows.quirks: At 150%+ the canvas is clipped by the 560px-ish tall canvas area at default window size; centered clipping hides the top/bottom/left/right strips equally. Hit-testing math divides by zoom so editing still works for visible parts.
rows.portTarget: Border overlay in Grid cell with Panel.ZIndex; backdrop blur has no WPF equivalent (use semi-opaque solid; or Acrylic via interop is overkill). Decide: add ScrollViewer/pan for zoom>fit (recommended fix) or keep clipping.
rows.parityCheck: Click + five times: 125/150/175/200/225%, max 300%; - to 25% min; canvas visual size = 585*zoom px. M3a smoke S8 (2026-10-14, UI Automation): label stepped to 300% and 25% and stopped; screenshots S08-zoom-*.png.
rows.divergence: 4.1: at zoom above fit the canvas is clipped with no scrollbars or pan so edges are unreachable. v5: scrollbars to pan when zoomed, zoom stays 25-300% in 0.25 steps.

rows.name: Select tool gestures: move, resize, rotate, wheel
rows.behavior: Mouse down in Select: if a layer is selected, test rotation handle first (hit radius 14 screen px, located 30px above the top edge along the layer's rotated up vector), then four corner handles (10 px radius, resize by distance ratio from center, uniform scale min 0.01, anchored at center), else topmost visible layer under the cursor (rotated-rect hit test) selects and starts a move drag (no undo entry), else deselect. Rotation snaps to multiples of 45 within 3 degrees (-180..180). Cursors: grab over rotation handle, grabbing while rotating, move while moving, nwse-resize while resizing (same for all corners), crosshair otherwise. Wheel over canvas in Select scales selected layer by 0.95/1.05 per event (min 0.01, no cap, updateUI so panel updates). Mouse leave or up ends the drag. Right/middle buttons are not filtered (any button starts a gesture). Selection chrome: 2px cyan dashed [5,5] box, 8x8 cyan corner squares, 1px-ish magenta stem + 8px magenta circle with white 1.5px ring and a small white arc arrow, and when rotation != 0 a magenta mono 11px label 'N.N°' 16 px above the handle.
rows.quirks: No undo for move/rotate/resize/wheel. mouse button not filtered. With draw tools, releasing the mouse outside the canvas leaves isDrawing true and the stroke keeps extending on re-entry (mouseleave only handles Select). Single click with pen/eraser (no movement) does nothing visible but still pushes an undo entry.
rows.portTarget: MouseDown/Move/Up on the SKElement with CaptureMouse (original loses the gesture when leaving the canvas; capture is an improvement). Reproduce hit-test radii in device pixels (not zoom scaled). Draw selection chrome in the same Skia pass (or a lightweight overlay).
rows.parityCheck: Pointer sequences through the bridge: a move drag at zoom 1 and 2, a corner drag whose scale ratio equals the distance ratio about a fixed center, a knob drag that snaps at 45 and wraps past 180 into the negative range (pointer 186 reads -173.66, about -174; 182 would snap to -180, 4.1's 3-degree band, editor.js:1176-1179), and wheel bursts up to the 500% clamp, each one undo step (bridge H1-H3); the same sequences through CanvasInteraction (LedgerScenarioTests, CanvasInteractionTests, SelectionGeometryTests). Narrowed in M4a: the gesture is real WPF routed input injected in-process by the test-only input bridge (brg smoke; interfaces R7, R8) and read back through its inspect command and UI Automation; the bridge cannot show the OS cursor image or drive a physical device (H1-H3).
rows.divergence: 4.1: any mouse button starts a gesture, no capture across the edge, rotation not normalized, hidden layers can show handles, wheel steps asymmetric with no clamp, and move/rotate/resize push no undo. v5: left button only, mouse capture, hover cursors, rotation normalized -180..180, no handles on hidden layers, symmetric centered wheel scaling with the 1%-500% clamp, and each gesture is one undo step.

rows.name: Drawing tools (pen, line, rect, ellipse) and eraser
rows.behavior: Mouse down pushes undo, creates an offscreen 585x559, pen/eraser begin a round-capped, round-joined path in drawColor (eraser uses magenta #f22f89 at 50% preview alpha); line/rect/ellipse live-preview with strokeStyle/fillStyle=drawColor and lineWidth=drawSize, rect and ellipse fill when drawFill. On mouse up: if any pixel alpha>0, pen/line/rect/ellipse -> autocrop (+10 pad) into a new layer named 'Pen drawing'/'Line drawing'/'Rect drawing'/'Circle drawing' (selected, no tool reset); eraser -> applyEraseStroke on the selected layer (lib/erase.js maps the stroke through the layer's inverse transform) replacing its image; with no selected layer an alert 'Select a layer to erase from, then try again.' shows AFTER the stroke. Eraser cursor is a generated SVG ring (radius = clamp(drawSize*zoom/2, 4..120), black 50% halo, magenta dashed ring, center dot) with hotspot at center and 'crosshair' fallback.
rows.quirks: Strokes are clipped to the 585x559 template area (stroke outside the canvas is lost). Zero-length pen click yields no layer but still an undo entry. Eraser can only erase the SELECTED layer.
rows.portTarget: Skia draw into SKBitmap/SKSurface; autocrop on alpha bbox; custom cursor: use an overlay ring drawn in the SKElement (avoids Windows cursor size limits) hiding the system cursor while the eraser is active.
rows.parityCheck: Shapes: GoldenAppTests shape-* scenes (M2a); eraser: GoldenAppTests erase-* scenes and EraserTests; pen: the approved divergence (ToolsTests). The eraser refuses at the press with a status message and no undo step is empty (LedgerScenarioTests, CanvasInteractionTests). Narrowed in M3b: pen strokes are not compared with 4.1 (approved divergence).
rows.divergence: 4.1: undo pushed on mousedown even for a zero-length click, pen re-strokes incrementally, and the eraser alerts after the stroke when no layer is selected. v5: pen strokes drawn once at mouseup, a press with no movement draws a brush-size dot, eraser refuses on mousedown with a status message when no layer is selected, and no empty undo steps.

rows.name: Export (Download template) pipeline
rows.behavior: If there is no visible layer, no region fill and no bg image, a native confirm() 'The template is empty — download a blank PNG anyway?' appears (Cancel aborts). Export draws a fresh 585x559 canvas: starts transparent, bg image (stretched, alpha=bgOpacity) or bg color fill (alpha=bgOpacity), regions, visible layers, then ALWAYS applies the region mask (destination-in) irrespective of the Mask checkbox. Does not include grid, checkerboard, selection chrome, or zoom. Saves via anchor download as '<sanitized title or roblox_shirt>_roblox.png' (sanitization [^a-zA-Z0-9_-] -> '_'), PNG with alpha.
rows.quirks: Mask checkbox does not affect export. Empty-check treats a hidden-layers-only document as empty even if hidden layers exist. Anti-aliased edges depend on GPU vs software canvas in Electron (spike finding) - native should be deterministic.
rows.portTarget: SKSurface 585x559 -> SKImage.Encode(Png) written via SaveFileDialog; MessageBox.Show(YesNo/OKCancel, 'The template is empty — download a blank PNG anyway?') with the same em dash text; compare against Electron export in the pixel-diff harness.
rows.parityCheck: Export output pixel-diff vs Electron (worst allowed 3/255 on AA edges per spike); alpha outside template = 0; filename test; empty-template prompt.

rows.name: Project save/load (.r15proj)
rows.behavior: Save writes pretty-printed JSON {version:'4.0' (still literal '4.0' in 4.1), app, savedAt ISO, mode, bgColor, bgOpacity, bgImageSrc (data URL or null), regionColors (fill descriptors or legacy color strings), showMask, showGrid, layers:[{id,name,visible,opacity,x,y,scale,rotation,flipH,flipV,brightness,contrast,saturate,hueRotate,rShift,gShift,bShift,imgSrc (data URL)}]} as .r15proj. Load (accepts .json,.r15proj): switchMode if mode present (no undo entry, history kept), restores bg/opacity, bg image, region fills (re-paints tiles), mask/grid checkboxes, then layers sorted by file order; nextId = max id + 1; selects the TOP layer. Any parse failure shows alert('Failed to load project. ' + err.message). Not saved: current tool, zoom, fill style, detail/word-art/brush settings, template name, undo history. Missing fields default (opacity 1, scale 1, adjustments 100/0, visible unless false).
rows.quirks: Edge: if the LAST layer in the file has no imgSrc, loading never completes finishing steps (loaded counter) so UI not rebuilt until another action. If every layer image fails to decode, Math.max(...[]) = -Infinity guarded only by the layers.length check. Version string stays '4.0'. Loading while an earlier project's images are mid-load can interleave.
rows.portTarget: System.Text.Json reader/writer with the same property names and base64 data-URL PNGs so existing v4 files open (spike confirmed readable); write 'version' per decision (keep '4.0' for compatibility or bump with back-compat reading).
rows.parityCheck: Open files saved by Electron 4.0 and 4.1 with several layers/adjustments: canvas pixel-diff equals Electron's rendering of the same file; round-trip save->load stable.
rows.divergence: 4.1: writes version '4.0', applies state before layers parse (half-loaded documents), and accepts any image source. v5: reads all 4.1 files, writes the same fields with version '5.0', all-or-nothing validated load, data: URLs only, and a visible warning naming dropped layers.

rows.name: What undo/redo snapshots and which actions push
rows.behavior: Snapshot (JSON) = mode, bgColor, bgOpacity, bgImageSrc, regionColors, showMask, showGrid, and all layers with image data URLs. Restore switches mode (wiping then re-applying region colors), re-syncs bg controls and checkboxes, repaints region tiles, reloads layer images asynchronously, preserving z-order by index, clears the selection. NOT captured: tool, zoom, brush/fill/detail/word-art settings, template name. Undo is pushed by: mode toggle, bg swatch, bg color/opacity pointerdown, bg image pick, add layer(any source), duplicate, delete, Clear, Fit Front/F+B/Stretch/Allover/Scatter, presets, region paint/clear/fit, region fill-style edits (only if painted regions exist), drawing mouse-down, detail buttons, word art add, right-click full-size asset. NOT pushed: layer move/rotate/resize drags, wheel scale, arrow-key nudges, rotate/scale keys, Flip, Up/Down, Center on front torso, X/Y/scale/rot/opacity/name edits, all adjustment sliders, Reset adjustments, Hide/Show, layer reorder? (reorder DOES push), Mask/Grid checkbox toggles (state is captured but toggling doesn't push).
rows.quirks: Undo of a move is impossible. Undo restore flashes (async image reload) and deselects.
rows.portTarget: Immutable state record + 30-deep undo list; image bitmaps shared by reference (not re-encoded) to avoid base64 cost. Keep the exact push/no-push list unless decisions are made per item.
rows.parityCheck: Replay the push/no-push list as unit tests: after each action assert history depth delta; Undo after Switch to Pants restores Shirt with fills (docs/SMOKE_TEST.md:56).
rows.divergence: 4.1: undo snapshots are re-encoded JSON, restore reloads images asynchronously and deselects, many mutations push no undo, and some push twice. v5: layers share immutable bitmaps, synchronous restore, selection survives undo, every document mutation is exactly one undo step (depth 30 kept), redo capped.

rows.name: Global keyboard shortcuts
rows.behavior: document.onkeydown ignores all keys when focus is in INPUT (including range sliders and checkboxes), SELECT, or TEXTAREA, and when Keys are OFF. Tool keys (case-insensitive, Ctrl NOT checked except for E and D): V select, B pen, L line, U rect, O ellipse (each toggles back to Select when already active), E eraser (only without Ctrl), Ctrl+D duplicate selected layer. Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z redo; Ctrl+Z undo (work with no selection). With a selected layer and no Ctrl/Meta: arrows move 1px (Shift = 10), [ and ] (or { }) rotate -/+ 5 deg (Shift = 15, wraps to -180..180), R resets rotation, +/= scale x1.1 (max 5), -/_ scale x0.9 (min 0.01), Delete/Backspace deletes the layer. All handled keys call preventDefault.
rows.quirks: Ctrl+B/L/U/O/V also trigger tools because only E and D check ctrl (Ctrl+V therefore selects Select; Ctrl+O would collide with a native Open shortcut if added). Backspace with a focused button still deletes a layer. After touching a slider or checkbox, shortcuts stay disabled until focus moves away (clicking the canvas moves focus to body). Slider arrow keys therefore never conflict. Shortcuts are not discoverable except via tooltips on the tool buttons and undo/redo.
rows.portTarget: Window.PreviewKeyDown handler with the same focus guard (TextBox/ComboBox/Slider/CheckBox focus suppresses, also ToggleButton? original suppresses only input/select/textarea so focused buttons still allow shortcuts). Map Key + Modifiers; note WPF Key.OemPlus for '+/=', Oem4/Oem6 for [ ].
rows.parityCheck: ShortcutRouterTests.RouteText_table_over_focus_modifiers_and_keys and the Route tables (every key over no focus, a TextBox, a Slider, a CheckBox, a Button, a layer row, a region tile and the 3D viewport, with no modifier, Shift, Ctrl and Alt, Keys on and off), plus the item 11 window facts (layer deltas, one undo step each) and ShellTests.The_window_binds_exactly_the_seven_chords_and_not_ctrl_v. Narrowed in M4b: Ctrl+V's paste moves to M5's paste row; M4b proves Ctrl+V toggles no tool and does nothing (K3; M4b smoke K2).
rows.divergence: 4.1: shortcuts are trapped by sliders and checkboxes, Ctrl+letter toggles tools, '[' rotation wraps incorrectly, and Keys OFF disables everything. v5: only text fields suppress shortcuts, Ctrl+letter no longer toggles tools, Ctrl+O/S/Shift+S/V added, Keys OFF disables only bare-key shortcuts, and '[' rotation wrap fixed. Character shortcuts ([ ] { } + = - _ r and the tool letters) match the typed character, so they follow the keyboard layout as 4.1's e.key did; an AltGr (Ctrl+Alt) character routes like the bare character while a lone Ctrl or Alt still blocks, and { and } always step 15, Shift or not (M4b, K2, D9, D15). Ctrl+V paste arrives with M5's paste row; in M4b Ctrl+V does nothing and toggles no tool (M4b, K3).

rows.name: All dialogs, prompts, toasts (complete list)
rows.behavior: There are NO toasts, snackbars, status bar, inline error banners or custom modals. Native blocking dialogs only: alert('Select a layer to erase from, then try again.') (editor.js:1270); confirm('The template is empty — download a blank PNG anyway?') (1506); alert('Built-in pack "<name>" not found. Reinstall the app to restore it.') (2344); alert('Built-in pack "<name>" is empty.') (2364); alert('No images found in that folder. Pick a folder with PNG, JPG, GIF, or WEBP files.') (2385); alert('Failed to load project. <error message>') (2676). Everything else fails silently with console.log/console.error only (skipped non-images, image decode failures, file reader errors). No-op feedback is also absent for placement/preset buttons without a selection. File pickers: hidden <input type=file> elements (project, image, bg, drop-zone, folder). The Electron window has no custom title bar, no About dialog, no help/menu.
rows.quirks: alert() blocks the renderer and shows the Electron page title as caption. confirm Cancel is a pure abort.
rows.portTarget: MessageBox.Show with identical captions/strings (title = app name) for the 5 alerts and the 1 confirm; add inline UX only by decision. Pickers per item. Decide whether to add silent-failure messages (recommended: a non-blocking InfoBar) while keeping the strings above intact.
rows.parityCheck: DialogInventoryTests map each of 4.1's six sites to its themed dialog or status text verbatim; through the bridge (F1, F4) all six fire on the running app and read verbatim through UI Automation: the empty-template confirm (editor.js:1506), the eraser refusal in the status strip (:1270), no images in the folder (:2385), a missing and an empty built-in pack (:2344, :2364) and 'Failed to load project. ...' (:2676), each dialog titled with the product name. Narrowed in M4a: the only other modal text is the Save / Don't save / Cancel prompt, which 4.1 never had (shell-unsaved-work-loss).
rows.divergence: 4.1: blocking native alert/confirm with no status feedback and silent console-only failures. v5: themed dialogs titled with the product name, message strings kept verbatim, and a status strip for previously console-only failures. The eraser's refusal (editor.js:1270) stays on the status strip at the press (eraser-selection-semantics, M3b); the only new modal is the unsaved-changes prompt (M4a, R13).

rows.name: Pants mode breaks layer-adding actions (static finding)
rows.behavior: Mode switch replaces SHIRT_REGIONS with PANTS_REGION_DATA (waist_*, rleg_*, lleg_* keys) but addLayer (editor.js:502), Center on front torso (855), Fit Front (1328), F+B (1339), word art add (2272), and every detail generator (1869-2060) still read SHIRT_REGIONS.torso_front/torso_back/rarm_*/larm_*, which are undefined in Pants mode, so they throw a TypeError (addLayer throws after saveUndo, so images cannot be added at all in Pants mode via Add image/drop zone/asset click; Sleeve Pop and Stretch also throw). Region fill painting, Allover, Scatter, region fit, bg and export still work. Found by reading; not executed (read-only task).
rows.quirks: Needs author confirmation: could be an intentional limitation ('pants have no torso') but there is no UI message. Reproduce in Electron before deciding keep vs fix.
rows.portTarget: Native port should resolve logical region names (Body/Front/Back/Up/Down/RightLimb/LeftLimb) through a mode-aware table so every action works in both modes (deliberate fix). Verify with the author whether the shipped 05-pants.png was created via fills only.
rows.parityCheck: In Pants mode: add image, Fit Front, detail buttons, Word Art all succeed in the native build (expected fix), while the Electron build throws; document as an intentional deviation and re-run the 4.1 pants screenshot scenario (camo on legs).
rows.divergence: 4.1: Pants mode swaps region tables so add image, Fit Front, Center, Word Art, Sleeve Pop and detail generators throw. v5: Pants mode works everywhere via semantic slots (front/back/rarm/larm/up/down per mode).

rows.name: Button visual states (base, hover, active, disabled)
rows.behavior: .btn: inline-flex centered, padding 8x16, no border, radius 6, 13px/600 Inter, transition 220ms. .btn-sm padding 5x10, 11px. .btn-primary: brand gradient bg, text #050c18, shadow 0 2px 8px rgba(23,212,250,.25); hover translateY(-1px) + duo glow. .btn-secondary: navy-soft->navy vertical gradient, text #fff, 1px border rgba(255,255,255,.08); hover cyan border + 0 0 8px rgba(23,212,250,.15) glow. .btn-active (tool on): cyan border, rgba(23,212,250,.1) bg, cyan text, all !important. :disabled: opacity .4, default cursor, no transform/shadow (Undo/Redo). Other button families: .preset-btn (navy, 1px border, 11px/500, hover cyan), .fill-type-btn and .wordart-style-btn (navy; .active = cyan border + cyan tint + cyan text), .ribbon-tab, .region-btn, zoom buttons (transparent 16px white). Dead families: .rbtn, .draw-tool-btn, .draw-tools, .preset-grid, .region-grid, .wordart-panel, .wordart-style-grid.
rows.quirks: No :active (pressed) style exists except layer-item cursor and resize handle; keep pressed state neutral.
rows.portTarget: A shared Styles.xaml: ButtonBase templates PrimaryButton, SecondaryButton, ToggleActiveButton, PresetButton, FillTypeButton (ToggleButton), with Trigger/VisualState for hover/pressed/disabled and DropShadowEffect glows. Do not port dead classes.
rows.parityCheck: State matrix screenshot (normal/hover/pressed/disabled/focus) per button family compared with the web build; disabled opacity exactly 0.4. Signed off at MAN-7 (Este, 2026-10-25, by eye in a live side-by-side with 4.1): the button state matrix on the look page.

rows.name: Inline styles override CSS (effective values)
rows.behavior: Much of editor.html styles elements inline, overriding the stylesheet: Home tab input/label colors (#888/#999/#666/#555), widths and padding of sliders and color boxes, Layout group grids (repeat(3,1fr), repeat(4,1fr)), preset button padding/font-size, wordart preview bg (#000), etc. The effective sizes are therefore the inline ones. Ribbon labels in Home (Fill/Mask/Grid/Opacity) are 9-10px muted gray; Text tab labels 8px #666 ('Fill','Stroke','Grad','Size','Stroke W','Angle'). Color inputs have `border:none` and widths 22-30px, heights 20-26px, radius 4 on drawColor only.
rows.quirks: Mixed token/hard-coded colors; keep for visual parity.
rows.portTarget: Port from the inline values, not from the unused CSS rules; build a one-line table per control in XAML (sizes: drawColor 26x24, drawSize 60w, fillColor1/2 26x22, fillAngle 44w, fillScale 44w, bgColor 30x24, bgOpacity 80w, detailColor 26x22, detailWidth 50w, wa colors 28x20, waSize 44w, waStrokeW 60w, waAngle 50w, waText 150w min 36h, waFont 150w, exportTitle 140w).
rows.parityCheck: Measure each control's bounding box from a 1920x1080 screenshot and compare with XAML (within 1 px). Signed off at MAN-7 (Este, 2026-10-25, by eye in a live side-by-side with 4.1): the control boxes on the look page.

rows.name: Text selection, context menu, tooltips
rows.behavior: Only layer rows (user-select:none) and the asset resize handle disable text selection; all other text (labels, headings, footer) is selectable by drag or double-click and Ctrl+A selects the whole page. Electron shows no default context menu (right-click is handled only on region tiles and asset thumbnails, otherwise nothing). Tooltips are native title= attributes (system delay ~500 ms) on: tool buttons, fill/brush/placement/file buttons, color/range inputs where set, layer row buttons, asset buttons, zoom? (none), resize handle ('Drag to resize'), swatches (names), asset thumbs (file name), subfolder buttons (folder). Several controls have no tooltip: Clear, Mode button, preset buttons, detail buttons, wordart style buttons, region tiles, zoom buttons.
rows.quirks: Selectable chrome text is accidental.
rows.portTarget: ToolTip on every control that has a title (strings listed in each item). Set TextBlock.IsHitTestVisible/Selectable false everywhere (WPF TextBlock is not selectable by default; accept deviation). No ContextMenu except where noted.
rows.parityCheck: Hover audit: every tooltip string matches the title attributes; no tooltip where none existed (unless added by decision). Signed off at MAN-7 (Este, 2026-10-25, by eye in a live side-by-side with 4.1): the hover and tooltip audit.
rows.divergence: 4.1: tooltips are native title= attributes, shown on mouse hover only. v5: a control's tooltip also shows while the control has keyboard focus and stays until focus moves, Esc or Ctrl (WPF's default, WCAG 1.4.13), so keyboard users read the same text; the tool tooltips drop their shortcut letters until M4's keys exist (measured M3b: the 52x26 and 162x26 windows under Color 1 and Add image).

rows.name: Pixel scale / DPI behavior
rows.behavior: CSS pixels throughout: canvas 585x559 at 100% is 585x559 CSS px, which Electron scales by the display's device pixel ratio (at 150% DPI the canvas bitmap is 585 px but displayed over 877 device pixels using Chromium resampling; the app sets no devicePixelRatio handling). The checker and zoom pipeline operate in CSS px. Fonts use px sizes (10-13 px mostly).
rows.quirks: Electron on high-DPI shows a softly resampled canvas at zoom 100% (nearest at zoom>=1 applies only in canvas space); native may look sharper. Pixel-diff only valid at 100% DPI.
rows.portTarget: WPF is DIP-based like CSS px; set UseLayoutRounding=True and SnapsToDevicePixels for 1px borders, and render the SKElement at device resolution (IgnorePixelScaling=false) so zoom 100% = 585 DIP. Decide whether on-screen preview should be crisp at high DPI (native improvement) while export remains 585x559.
rows.parityCheck: By hand in the M4a manual list (MAN-3): at 100% and at 125% or 150% display scale the layout matches in DIPs and the export is 585x559. Narrowed in M4a: two display scales, not four.

rows.name: Initial window 1200x800, centered, resizable
rows.behavior: BrowserWindow created with width 1200, height 800 (outer size incl. frame), no x/y so Electron centers it on the primary display; no minWidth/minHeight, no maxWidth, resizable, maximizable, minimizable, fullscreenable all left at defaults. No backgroundColor and no show:false, so a white window can flash before editor.html paints. TEST_PLAN asserts 'Window opens at 1200x800, centered'.
rows.quirks: No minimum size, so the UI can be shrunk until panels overlap. Port should either keep (parity) or add a sane MinWidth; log the choice.
rows.portTarget: MainWindow.xaml Width=1200 Height=800 WindowStartupLocation=CenterScreen. Note Electron 1200x800 is the OUTER size in DIPs; WPF Width/Height is also outer, so use the same numbers. Set Background to brand navy #0f1f31 so there is no white flash. Decide MinWidth/MinHeight (Electron had none; the editor layout likely breaks when small).
rows.parityCheck: Launch at 100% and 150% DPI on a 1920x1080 screen; screenshot window rect and confirm 1200x800 DIP and centered within 1px. Resize to very small and compare behavior.
rows.divergence: 4.1: fixed 1200x800 centered window with no memory of size or position. v5: window remembers size and position. The window has a 640x480 minimum (4.1 had none, and its panels overlapped when shrunk).

rows.name: Window title is a static product name
rows.behavior: title option is 'RBX15 Classic Shirt and Pants Maker'. editor.html <title> has the same text, and Electron lets the HTML title override the option, so the title never changes (no dirty marker, no project name, no '*'). Title is shown in the caption bar and taskbar tooltip.
rows.quirks: None. Project name never appears in the title; port may keep that.
rows.portTarget: Window.Title="RBX15 Classic Shirt and Pants Maker" (use a localizable resource). Keep static unless a deliberate improvement (project name) is approved.
rows.parityCheck: Read the top-level window title via UI Automation (Name property) and compare to the exact string. M3a smoke S1 (2026-10-14, automated via UI Automation): window Name read as "RBX15 Classic Shirt and Pants Maker".

rows.name: No window or exe icon configured
rows.behavior: BrowserWindow sets no icon and package.json build has no icon / win.icon, no build/ directory exists, and no .ico is tracked. Result: the NSIS .exe, installer, taskbar entry in dev, and desktop shortcut all use the default Electron icon. Only the MSIX path has brand art (tiles in windows/msix/Images).
rows.quirks: Electron-default icon on non-Store builds is probably an unnoticed defect; fix, do not copy.
rows.portTarget: Add a multi-size app.ico (16-256) as <ApplicationIcon> in the csproj and set Window.Icon. MSIX tiles come from the manifest. This is a free upgrade over parity; generate the .ico from the same brand mark as make-msix-images.py.
rows.parityCheck: M6a: the published exe's icon resource is the brand mark (System.Drawing ExtractAssociatedIcon on RBX15.App.exe, read back as the template-cross tile); the running main window answers WM_GETICON (small and big) with a non-null icon, which is what the title bar, taskbar and Alt-Tab draw; the MSIX Start tile is Images/Square44x44Logo.png by the manifest. Taskbar and Alt-Tab were not eyeballed.
rows.divergence: 4.1: NSIS exe and window use the default Electron icon (no icon configured). v5: brand app icon on the exe, window and MSIX tiles.

rows.name: nodeIntegration:true, contextIsolation:false in the renderer
rows.behavior: The renderer has full Node access (require('fs'), require('path'), process.resourcesPath, __dirname used directly in editor.js). This was the PR #27 injection sink (layer name -> innerHTML -> code execution). No sandbox, no CSP meta tag, no preload, no IPC channels at all.
rows.quirks: Port should keep a hostile-name regression test even though the vector is gone, because names are also used to build export filenames (see export filename sanitization).
rows.portTarget: Disappears in WPF: there is no web content. The only Node uses (fs.readdirSync/readFileSync of packs, process.resourcesPath) become File/Directory APIs. The injection class of bug is structurally gone; keep the intent as a test (layer names with quotes, <, & render as literal text and round-trip in .r15proj).
rows.parityCheck: Load a project whose layer name is `">`; confirm literal text in Name box and layer list, no dialog, name survives save/load.
rows.divergence: 4.1: renderer runs with nodeIntegration true and contextIsolation false (the PR #27 injection sink). v5: no web content or Node in the renderer, with a hostile-layer-name regression test kept.

rows.name: Menu bar hidden via setMenuBarVisibility(false); default menu still exists
rows.behavior: win.setMenuBarVisibility(false) hides the menu bar but does NOT remove the default Electron application menu. Consequences: Alt toggles the bar back on temporarily, and the default menu accelerators stay live: Ctrl+R / F5 reload (destroys all unsaved work, no beforeunload guard), Ctrl+Shift+I devtools (SMOKE_TEST relies on it), Ctrl+Plus/Ctrl+Minus/Ctrl+0 page zoom, F11 fullscreen, Ctrl+W/Alt+F4 close, Ctrl+Shift+R hard reload, and standard edit-menu roles (cut/copy/paste/select all) that make text boxes work.
rows.quirks: Ctrl+R wiping the session is a data-loss quirk (the editor only ignores Ctrl+R for rotation, CHANGELOG 4.1.0, it does not block the reload). Recommend fix: inert. Page zoom with Ctrl+/- scales the whole UI and canvas hit-testing may break; recommend not porting.
rows.portTarget: WPF has no default menu; nothing to hide. Decide per accelerator: F11 fullscreen (optional), Ctrl+/- zoom (the editor has its own canvas zoom, so page zoom is probably unwanted), Ctrl+R reload (do NOT port). Standard text editing in TextBox is free. Add Alt+F4 default.
rows.parityCheck: Press Ctrl+R, F5, Ctrl+Shift+I, F11, Ctrl+=, Alt in Electron build and record what happens; in native build confirm each is either intentionally supported or inert and never loses work.
rows.divergence: 4.1: hidden default Electron menu leaves Ctrl+R/F5 reload (wipes unsaved work), devtools and page-zoom accelerators live. v5: no default menu, so none of these accelerators exist.

rows.name: DevTools do not auto-open
rows.behavior: openDevTools is commented out in main.js; the 4.0.0 fix removed a leftover call. Packaged build opens clean; Ctrl+Shift+I still opens it through the default menu.
rows.quirks: The smoke-test checklist requires a clean DevTools console. The port needs an equivalent 'no unhandled exceptions' signal (e.g. DispatcherUnhandledException logs to file, tests assert empty).
rows.portTarget: No equivalent needed. Provide logging to %LOCALAPPDATA% or Debug output instead; optionally a hidden diagnostics toggle.
rows.parityCheck: Launch packaged build; no secondary window or docked panel appears.
rows.divergence: 4.1: DevTools exist but do not auto-open. v5: no DevTools; unhandled exceptions are logged instead.

rows.name: Quit on last window closed; macOS activate branch is dead code
rows.behavior: window-all-closed quits the app unless platform is darwin; the activate handler re-creates a window only when none exist (macOS only in practice). Closing the one window exits the process immediately with NO unsaved-work prompt and no autosave.
rows.quirks: Silent data loss on close is current behavior; the port should decide explicitly. Because the editor does not track a 'dirty' flag today, adding a prompt is a new feature, not parity.
rows.portTarget: Application.ShutdownMode=OnMainWindowClose; no close confirmation for parity. Drop the darwin branch. Consider (flagged improvement) an unsaved-changes prompt since history already tracks dirty state.
rows.parityCheck: Add a layer, click close: app exits with no dialog, no residual process in Task Manager (native: 1 process, Electron: 4).
rows.divergence: 4.1: closing the window exits immediately with no unsaved-work prompt and no autosave. v5: save-changes prompt on close with dirty tracking, backed by autosave and crash recovery.

rows.name: No single-instance lock
rows.behavior: app.requestSingleInstanceLock is never called, so launching the exe twice (or Start tile twice) opens two independent windows/processes. Under MSIX the same applies since the app is FullTrust.
rows.quirks: Two instances do not share state; harmless because nothing persists. Keep.
rows.portTarget: WPF: no lock by default, which matches. If desired later, a named Mutex. Decide keep (parity) vs add; log it.
rows.parityCheck: Launch exe twice; count top-level windows (native expectation: 2 unless a decision is made to single-instance).

rows.name: Zero persisted settings: window rect, tool state, last folder, template name
rows.behavior: No localStorage, sessionStorage, electron-store, config file, or registry use anywhere (grep of editor.js finds none). Window size/position, zoom, selected tab, Keys ON/OFF, mask/grid toggles, last-used folder, export title all reset every launch. PRIVACY.md states 'the app has no persistent settings file'. History is memory only.
rows.quirks: Electron still writes Chromium cache dirs (Cache, GPUCache, Network, Local Storage) under %APPDATA%\<productName>; Electron's uninstall leaves them behind. The 'no hidden data' privacy claim is slightly off for the Electron build; native build makes it exactly true.
rows.portTarget: Do not add a settings store without updating PRIVACY.md and the Store privacy answers. Native app writes nothing outside user-chosen files (plus optional crash log decision). MSIX will create the per-package LocalState folder automatically but it stays empty.
rows.parityCheck: Run Process Monitor on native build through a full session: only reads of install dir, user-chosen files, and fonts; no writes outside chosen save paths. Compare to Electron build, which writes Cache, GPUCache, Local Storage, etc. under %APPDATA%.
rows.divergence: 4.1: zero persisted settings and no hidden data. v5: remembers window rect, autosaves every 60s while dirty for crash recovery, and keeps 10 recent projects and a jump list, with PRIVACY docs updated to match.

rows.name: Export PNG edges depend on Electron GPU canvas vs software canvas
rows.behavior: Per spike findings, antialiased shape edges differ slightly between GPU-rasterized and software-rasterized canvas (max 3/255 vs Skia raster). Export uses canvas.toDataURL('image/png') on a 585x559 canvas after paintRegions, layers with ctx.filter adjustments, and destination-in maskCanvas.
rows.quirks: Electron exports are not byte-stable across machines today; the native build will be. Not user-visible but worth stating in release notes if anyone diffs files.
rows.portTarget: SKBitmap 585x559 N32 premul RGBA8888, SKCanvas software raster only (deterministic across machines). Export via SKImage.Encode(Png, 100). Sets the new truth for exports.
rows.parityCheck: Pixel-diff harness: exported PNG from native vs Electron with GPU disabled (--disable-gpu): zero diff except AA edge pixels, max channel delta <=3. Native vs native across two machines: byte-identical.
rows.divergence: 4.1: export edge pixels vary between GPU and software canvas and are not byte-stable across machines. v5: deterministic CPU-Skia export, byte-identical across machines.

rows.name: Dropping files outside the drop zone/canvas is swallowed, not navigated
rows.behavior: document-level dragover and drop call preventDefault so a file dropped on panels/ribbon does not make Electron navigate to the file (which would replace the editor). Only #dropZone and the canvas accept drops (dropZone also stops propagation).
rows.quirks: Drop of non-image files is silently ignored (verify in the editor slice).
rows.portTarget: WPF: AllowDrop=True only on drop zone and canvas host; leave AllowDrop False elsewhere. Handle DragOver feedback (dragover class highlight on the drop zone). Accept file lists of images (png/jpg/gif/webp via isImageFile).
rows.parityCheck: By hand in the M4a manual list (MAN-1): a PNG dragged from Explorer over the layers panel and the ribbon shows the no-drop cursor and does nothing; dropped on the drop zone it highlights the zone and lands centered in the front slot; dropped on the canvas it lands centered on the drop point. Narrowed in M4a: a hand check, because an OLE drag from another process is outside the bridge (interfaces R8).

rows.name: Exports and project saves go through anchor-download, relying on Chromium/Electron's Save As behavior
rows.behavior: Export: builds an <a download> with a data: URL and .click(); Save Work: Blob + object URL + click then revoke immediately. In Electron with no will-download handler, a native Save As dialog opens with the suggested filename; the user picks the location. There is no default folder set, no 'last used' memory, no overwrite warning beyond the OS dialog, and nothing is shown after saving (no toast).
rows.quirks: Verify the actual Electron default start folder (expected Downloads) and keep or change deliberately. Cancel path currently silent. Object URL is revoked synchronously right after click; works only because Chromium has started the fetch.
rows.portTarget: Microsoft.Win32.SaveFileDialog (or Windows.Storage.Pickers with window handle) with filter 'PNG image|*.png' and 'RBX15 project|*.r15proj', FileName seeded from the sanitized title, OverwritePrompt=true, AddExtension. Defaults: initial directory = user's Documents/Pictures (decide; Electron default is Downloads).
rows.parityCheck: Through the bridge (F1): with the title 'My Shirt v2!' Download template suggests My_Shirt_v2__roblox.png and writes a 585x559 RGBA PNG, a cancel writes nothing and shows nothing, and Save As suggests My_Shirt_v2_.r15proj; RendererTests pin 'My Shirt!' to My_Shirt__roblox.png and My_Shirt_.r15proj. Narrowed in M4a: the dialogs are the bridge's file-dialog queue, which logs each suggested name; the native dialogs are Win32FileDialogs (FileGroupTests, ProjectFileServiceTests).
rows.divergence: 4.1: Electron anchor-download Save As with no current-file memory and no feedback after saving. v5: native save/open/folder dialogs with a current-file model and a status message.

rows.name: Filename derivation and sanitization
